title: Account Executive | Fund Administration | VC | DE (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at bunch
description_html:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

  • This role is key to supporting bunch's growth going forward. You will establish and execute our commercial strategy with Enterprise customers, including larger VC funds, leading to bunch becoming the industry standard for private market investments.

  • A successful hire will contribute to setting our Commercial strategy at pace. You will play a key role in building further market knowledge and relations with potential VC customers, supporting bunch during a pivotal time.

Top responsibilities

  • Acquire new Enterprise customers across our markets (inbound and outbound).

  • Co-build a commercial acquisition strategy for new customer segments, mostly large Venture Capital funds.

  • Build and maintain relationships between bunch and i) General Partners (GPs) / CFOs / COOs of prospect and client funds, and ii) Angel investors.

  • Understand the pain points faced by prospects and customers to develop account plans for specific lists of target accounts, including demand generation and closing plans.

  • Stay informed about the competitive landscape to create winning proposals and pricing strategies.

  • Collaborate with the Strategy, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to develop best practices for generating demand and increasing customer engagement within the target accounts.

  • Create business cases that demonstrate the business value and return on investment clients can expect by using bunch.

  • Nurture client relationships, strive for process excellence that allows us to maximise customer satisfaction and ensure long-term retention.

About You

  • 3+ years of experience as an Account Executive or in a commercial role, ideally within the private investment market.

  • A local network of Fund Managers is a strong differentiator.

  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills that enable you to gain trust through authenticity, expertise, and rapport-building.

  • A results-oriented, impact-driven mindset: you're curious to understand the broader context and expected outcomes, and you approach tasks with an entrepreneurial spirit to get things done.

  • Customer-centricity: you proactively understand and champion our customers' goals, always striving to provide value and align with their objectives.

  • Operational excellence in SaaS sales: you're skilled in optimising the sales process, analysing conversion rates, managing end-to-end sales funnels, and ensuring pipeline efficiency.

  • Business-level fluency in English.

Workplace and Benefits

  • Join our Commercial team during a pivotal time and high growth momentum

  • Take part in a network of people passionate about investment and work closely with the most interesting players in the private market.

  • Benefit from working with a diverse mix of talents, unrivalled energy and team spirit within a culture of drive and ownership.

  • Flexible hours, hybrid office setup, and 28 days of vacation per year plus public holidays.

  • A competitive compensation package.

  • A great tech and work setup with everything you need.

What your interview journey will look like

  • Initial call with the People team (30 min) to get to know more about the role

  • Deep Dive with a Team member (30 min) for us to learn more about your ways of working

  • Case Study Interview with the team (60 min) for us to get a sense of how you approach Sales

  • Optional Meet & Greet: Meeting our Stakeholders at bunch Offices (2 x 30min)

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.


____

At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants.

We process personal data in line with applicable laws (including GDPR). See our Privacy Policy for details on your rights and how to reach us.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager | Tech (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at bunch
description_html:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your role

As Talent Acquisition Manager — Tech at bunch, you will own end-to-end hiring across Engineering, Product, Design and Analytics. You will build high-quality technical pipelines, translate business needs into structured hiring strategies, and partner with technical leaders to make sound, evidence-based hiring decisions.

You will:

  • Own assigned technical searches from kick-off through accepted offer and onboarding handover, turning role outcomes into clear scorecards, interview plans, sourcing strategies and delivery forecasts

  • Build targeted outbound pipelines, engage passive technical talent with relevant communication and develop reusable talent maps and relationships across referrals and technical communities

  • Partner with hiring managers on talent availability, location, compensation, level and search feasibility, while maintaining a high bar for interview quality, timely feedback and consistent assessment

  • Manage competing searches through explicit priorities, milestones, pipeline coverage and risk signals, keeping Ashby workflows, reporting and role-level forecasts accurate

  • Create a strong candidate experience and close effectively by understanding motivation, concerns and decision criteria early, then communicating clearly throughout the process

  • Use AI and automation to improve research, preparation, reporting and follow-up while retaining human judgment, data quality and accountability

About you

  • You have 3+ years of experience in end-to-end recruitment, with meaningful ownership of technical roles in a fast-moving environment

  • A mix of agency and startup experience is a plus

  • You have hired for a diverse set of roles and seniorities within Engineering, Product, Design, and Data

  • You are intrinsically self-starting: you identify gaps, form a point of view, propose solutions and close loops without needing detailed direction

  • You are resilient and persistent when searches, stakeholders or candidates become difficult, while recognising when to change course

  • You are curious about technical work, talent markets and the business, and learn quickly enough to calibrate credibly with Engineering, Product and Analytics leaders

  • You are a creative sourcer who develops new talent pools, messages and routes to market when the standard process is not enough

  • You value structured kick-offs, scorecards, ATS discipline and data, but understand that process supports judgment rather than replacing it

  • You use recruiting data, AI and automation responsibly without outsourcing human judgment

What success looks like

  • Own it: Take end-to-end accountability for searches, candidate commitments and stakeholder follow-through. Surface risks early with a proposed solution and learn openly from mistakes.

  • Aim for impact: Focus on hiring work that moves the needle. Connect priorities to business and team outcomes, make explicit trade-offs and keep quality as part of speed.

  • Empower others: Invest time, empathy and recruiting expertise in candidates, hiring managers and teammates. Improve interview quality and help others make better decisions.

  • Always be curious: Ask why, challenge assumptions and continuously learn about technical roles, the talent market and bunch’s business. Turn each search into reusable insight.

  • Enjoy the ride: Bring warmth, authenticity and constructive energy to demanding work. Stay calm under pressure, recognise progress and help the team navigate setbacks together.

Workplace & benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid work with 3 days per week in the office in Mitte

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks per year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team interview with Roberto — 45 min: Motivation and the five values that matter most for operating in a fast-paced environment.

  2. Technical recruiting live case — 60 min: A conversational interview about real and situational recruiting decisions, stakeholder management, and team dynamics. No take-home assignment.

  3. Cross-functional round — 3 × 30 min: Conversations with an Engineering or Product Leaders, People Partner and People Lead.

Questions? Reach out to

  • About bunch — Our mission, product and journey so far

  • Case Studies — About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights — Our latest bunch of blog posts

  • Glossary — Explore commonly used private-market terms

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: (Senior) Full-Stack Engineer | Frontend-leaning | Platform Team (f/m/d) | Berlin
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at bunch
description_html:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your role

You’ll join our Platform team as a Full Stack Engineer with a frontend focus, building the foundational product experiences and services that power bunch. We’re looking for someone who sees product development as a craft - a blend of technical excellence, user-centered thinking, and cross-functional collaboration.

Whether you’re shaping frontend architecture, contributing to backend services, maintaining our Design System, or implementing features end to end, your work will have a direct impact on thousands of users managing billions in assets. We offer you freedom and ownership to build the right solutions and influence the product roadmap.

Top responsibilities

  • Build robust, scalable, and well-tested full-stack product features, with a strong focus on frontend quality, using modern frameworks and our in-house Design System

  • Collaborate with PMs, Designers, QAs, and Engineers in the Platform Core team to ship high-quality features quickly

  • Contribute to and evolve our frontend architecture, backend services, tooling, and design system

  • Ensure a great developer experience and continuously improve performance, reliability, and maintainability across the stack

  • Write meaningful unit and E2E tests

  • Actively shape product solutions by participating in discovery, feedback rounds, and design critiques

If you're applying as a Senior:

  • Take ownership across the stack, with particular depth in the frontend domain, and influence platform-wide decisions

  • Drive alignment between design and development, and collaborate on challenging UX cases

  • Own and evolve our in-house Design System alongside the design team

  • Guide the team in architecture and performance decisions

  • Mentor and support other engineers

About You

To thrive in our Platform Core team, you combine a love for building excellent UIs with the ability to work confidently across the stack and a pragmatic, product-first mindset. You're a strong communicator, a team player, and someone who thrives in a growing, fast-paced environment where asking "why" is encouraged.

You...

  • Have 5+ years (Senior) of experience building product applications across the stack, with clear frontend depth

  • Are fluent in TypeScript, comfortable with modern frontend frameworks, and able to contribute to Node.js backend services

  • Have experience working with Design Systems

    • for Senior: also experience building or maintaining custom ones

  • Are familiar with unit and E2E testing (Vitest, Playwright, or equivalents)

  • Understand UI/UX principles and care about building elegant, accessible, and usable interfaces

  • Can operate in ambiguity and turn loosely defined ideas into working software

  • Have experience in a startup or scaleup environment

Nice to have:

  • Previous exposure to fintech or highly regulated domains

  • Experience with zod (or any other form validation tools)

  • Worked with data visualisations (e.g., tables, charts)

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: Svelte + SvelteKit but moving towards React + TanStack, TypeScript, MeltUI (headless components) but moving towards Shadcn, Felte + zod

  • Testing: Vitest (unit), Playwright (E2E)

  • Design System: Custom-built (MeltUI)

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, MySQL, Sequelize

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (K8S) on top of AWS

Workplace & Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Interview Process

  • First interview with the People team (30 min): get acquainted with bunch and to understand if what we’re offering is what you’re searching for

  • Hiring Manager Interview (60 min): this conversation with an Engineering Manager will cover product-focused culture and values, including collaboration, ownership, self-awareness, and quality standards.

  • Technical Interview (60 min): this interview in the form of a technical conversation with two engineers will focus on collaborative problem-solving, starting with open-ended questions and progressing to more specific challenges or short algorithm tasks.

  • Final Round: Meet our VP of Engineering (45 min): learn about ways of working, vision for bunch, and team culture.

title: Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at GALVANY
description_html:
At GALVANY, our goal is to make climate-neutral living a reality for everyone. We focus on execution – developing concrete, smart solutions and making heat pumps, battery storage, and smart metering easy to access, reliable, and affordable. GALVANY-Tech drives the energy transition through software. We're building an AI-based Operating System for sales, planning, installation and operation of heat pumps and integrated energy systems – from single-family homes to multi-unit buildings, and across our Energy Community as a Virtual Power Plant.

We are a profitable green-tech startup and believe that sustainable impact and long-term growth are only possible when grounded in a healthy business model. Driven by customer value, clarity, and responsibility, we stand for high-quality heating solutions and an environment where people take responsibility and drive lasting impact.

The Role

As an Engineering Lead at GALVANY, you will shape the technical direction of critical product domains within our AI-based Operating System. Whether you're driving our ERP, automation, and AI agent systems or our CRM and customer-facing apps – you'll own architecture decisions, elevate your team, and bridge the gap between engineering and the wider business. You combine deep technical expertise with the ability to align stakeholders and mentor engineers.

Responsibilities:

  • Own architectural decisions for your domain and drive long-term technical vision.

  • Lead a team of engineers: hire, develop, and retain talent through coaching, code reviews, and continuous feedback.

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and clear technical guidance.

  • Stay hands-on: contribute directly to the codebase alongside architectural and leadership responsibilities.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Operations to align technical decisions with business goals.

  • Balance innovation with pragmatism – make smart build-vs-buy decisions at system level.

  • Integrate LLMs and AI agents into product workflows where they create real value.

  • Drive operational excellence: observability, reliability, and incident response.

Tech Stack: Backend with GoLang and Laravel; ML with Python, PyTorch, and LLMs; Frontend with React, Tailwind, and Shadcn; Mobile with Flutter; General tools including Azure, GitHub, Linear, Notion, Kafka, Benthos (data pipeline), n8n / Kestra (workflow engine), and low-code process automation platforms.

Requirements

  • Experience. 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years of technical leadership in high-performance environments (e.g. fast-scaling startups or similar).

  • Track Record. Proven end-to-end responsibility in software engineering and technical leadership. From ideation to release.

  • Background. Strong background in relevant fields, e.g. Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar.

  • Technical Skills. Strong system design and coding skills with proficiency in Go, or similar. Experience with event-driven architectures and distributed systems. Fluent in spec-driven, AI-assisted development (e.g. Claude Code).

  • Mindset. Self-driven problem-solving mindset – no need for micromanagement or specific tickets.

  • Technical Aptitude. Technical mindset with a passion for understanding systems, data flows, and integrations, coupled with enthusiasm for continuous learning and problem solving.

  • Language. Fluent in English (C1); German (B2)

Skills and Qualities That Are Important to Us

  • Outcome-Led. You focus on value over volume. You embrace iteration, adapt quickly to new information, and prioritize what moves the needle for business and user.

  • Systems Thinker. You see the bigger picture. You understand how your work connects to the wider ecosystem – ensuring features contribute to a cohesive, scalable whole.

  • Pragmatic. You choose the simplest effective path to solve problems – especially by leveraging AI tools.

  • Customer Champion. You keep the end-user central in all decisions. You seek direct exposure to how customers experience the product.

  • Team Multiplier. You take responsibility for your team's success – setting direction, removing blockers, and developing people. You make the team better, not just the code.

  • Cross-Functional Bridge. You translate between Engineering, Product, and Ops. You build alignment on technical decisions with non-technical stakeholders.

title: Process Engineer (m/f/d)

description_html:
About Rohlik Group

Rohlik Group is Europe's leading online grocery delivery service. Using technology, we deliver a weekly shop of 25,000 SKUs in under three hours, in 15-minute delivery slots — giving our customers back their time, freedom and flexibility.

We believe the world needs a better food system: more sustainable, more inclusive, and bringing healthier, more personalised food to everyone. In every city we operate, we handpick the best and freshest local produce — from butchers to bakeries — and work directly with farmers through our Farm-to-Door program, alongside the trusted brands and affordable own-label products our customers love.

About the Team

The Automation team designs and implements the innovative processes, equipment and automation solutions that shape Rohlik's fulfillment network. Working closely with local and central teams, we drive scalability, efficiency and innovation across every part of our operations.

The Role

As a Process Engineer, you'll own end-to-end improvement projects across our fulfillment network — from spotting a process that's slow, costly or manual, to delivering a live, working solution on the warehouse floor. Your projects will span both hardware (robotics, automated material handling, conveyor and packing systems) and software (control logic and orchestration optimisation), using whichever combination best solves the problem.

 

What We Offer

  • Unlimited vacation days for a balanced work-life balance

  • Monthly vouchers: €45 tax-free (via become.1)

  • €20 monthly allowance towards internet costs

  • Knuspr Xtra account with 10% discount in the form of Knuspr Credits (cashback)

  • Great discounts via CorporateBenefits (fitness, travel, tickets, shopping, and much more)

  • Rohlik Vibe: an international team, flat hierarchies, and an informal culture where mistakes are seen as learning opportunities

 

What You'll Do

  • Identify improvement potential across the fulfillment network — on the floor, in the data, and with operations teams — wherever automation or process redesign can meaningfully improve cost, throughput, quality or safety

  • Own the business case for each opportunity: quantify throughput gains and labour impact, calculate payback period, prepare capex/opex estimates, and defend the investment to senior stakeholders

  • Own the full solution end to end, whatever form it takes — physical automation, software/control changes, or a combination of both

  • Standardise delivered work into reusable templates, playbooks and best practices that accelerate future projects

  • Lead implementation from design through testing, installation, integration and piloting, coordinating internal teams, vendors and contractors to deliver a working solution on site

  • Partner with Procurement and Operations across the full lifecycle — from requirements, RFIs/RFQs, vendor evaluation and commercial negotiation, through to a clean handover with documentation, SOPs, support processes and training for operational teams

  • Feed insights from delivered projects into the group automation roadmap and warehouse planning concepts

  • Support site and regional leadership by translating process and performance data into prioritised improvement opportunities

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Degree in engineering, a technical/analytical field (e.g., mechanical, mechatronics, industrial engineering, logistics), or an equivalent completed vocational training (Ausbildung) / relevant hands-on experience

  • 3+ years of experience in warehouse automation (e.g., robotics, AMRs, AutoStore, sorters, conveyors, packing systems) and process improvement, including end-to-end project ownership from concept to handover

  • Strong analytical skills, capable of both spreadsheet business modeling and floor-level process evaluation

  • Proven project management ability to align Operations, Engineering, Finance, and external vendors

  • Strong negotiation and engagement skills with third-party vendors and contractors

  • Broad interest in both the hardware and software sides of automation

  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken)

  • Willingness to spend regular time on-site at fulfillment centers

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with control logic, orchestration software or WMS integration

  • Working knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies

Verantwortlichkeiten

 Das Ziel der Stelle ist die operative und organisatorische Leitung des Standorts Frankfurt Der Standortleiter ist erster Ansprechpartner in allen Belangen und trägt die Gesamtverantwortung für die effiziente Steuerung der Standortaktivitäten, insbesondere auch arbeitsrechtskonforme Umsetzung der  Schichtplanung. Dabei wird besonderes Augenmerk auf operative Exzellenz, Mitarbeiterführung sowie Kunden- und Prozessmanagement gelegt.

Aufgabenbereiche 

  •          Operative Leitung und Prozessmanagement

  •          Umsetzung und Kontrolle von Prozessoptimierungen zur Steigerung der Effektivität und Effizienz.

  •          Überwachung und Steuerung der Einhaltung aller relevanten gesetzlichen und betrieblichen Vorschriften, insbesondere im Bereich Zoll und Logistik.

  •          Eigenverantwortliches Vorantreiben der Digitalisierung am Standort nach Rücksprache und Vorgaben des Managementteams

  •          Sicherstellung der Einhaltung und Nachverfolgung der standortbezogenen KPI´s.

Kundenmanagement

  •          Aufbau und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen, einschließlich regelmäßiger Kommunikation mit Bestandskunden.

  •          Unterstützung bei der Akquisition neuer Kunden und Geschäftspartner.

  •          Anlaufstelle für Kundenanfragen, Reklamationen und individuelle Lösungsfindung.

Schnittstellenmanagement 

  •          Koordination und Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen (z. B. HR, IT, Finance) sowie externen Dienstleistern.

  •          Unterstützung bei Kommunikation mit EDV-Dienstleistern (z. B. dbh, DAKOSY, CargoSoft) bei IT-Themen oder Prozessanpassungen.

  •          Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung/Head of Operations zur Abstimmung standortübergreifender Maßnahmen und Ziele.

Mitarbeiterführung

  •          Führung und Entwicklung des Standortteams, inklusive regelmäßiger Feedback- und Zielvereinbarungsgespräche.

  •          Organisation und Durchführung von Standortmeetings (mindestens 1x monatlich).

  •          Verantwortung für die Einsatz- und Schichtplanung der Mitarbeitenden (inkl. Urlaubsplanung und Freigabe Überstunden)

  •          Förderung des Teamspirits durch Planung und Durchführung von Teamevents.

Finanzielle Verantwortung 

  •          Unterstützung bei standortbezogenen Finanzfragen, wie Budgetplanung und Kontrolle.

  •          Verantwortung für Umsatz- und Kostenkontrolle am Standort.

  •          Berichtswesen (Umsatz, Kundenstatistik, Personalsituation) an die Geschäftsführung/Head of Operations.

Kommunikationsaufgaben

  •          Förderung einer offenen Fehlerkultur durch transparente Kommunikation und Aufarbeitung von Fehlern.

  •          Sicherstellung einer effektiven internen Kommunikation innerhalb des Teams und mit den anderen Standorten / Abteilungen.

  •          Einführung und Aufrechterhalten eines Postclearance Prozesses zur rechtskonformen Nachbearbeitung von überlassenen Zollanmeldungen im Fall von Fehlern

  •          Einführung eines Qualitätssicherungssystem um Fehler zu identifizieren, zu korrigieren und die Eintrittswahrscheinlichkeit zu reduzieren

Kompetenzen / Entscheidungsbefugnisse

  •          Weisungsbefugnis gegenüber allen operativen Mitarbeitenden des Standorts.

  •          Entscheidung über die Priorisierung von operativen Aufgaben in Abstimmung mit dem Head of Operations.

  •          Erstellung von Angeboten in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb.

  •          Vorschläge zu leistungsorientierten Bonuszahlungen, in Absprache mit dem Head of Operations.

  •          Handlungsbevollmächtigter im Rahmen der übertragenen Kompetenzen

title: Data Scientist (m/w/d)

description_html:
Make impact. Be human. Stay curious.

Who we are

Founded in 2006, Rewire is an applied AI company helping organizations reinvent how they work with data and AI. We partner with leading organizations across industries to create scalable business impact by solving complex challenges through data, AI, and technology. Our team of 100+ data scientists, engineers, and change agents operates across Europe from offices in the Netherlands and Germany. Strategic in intent and pragmatic in execution, we combine deep Data & AI expertise with close, committed collaboration.

Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are at the heart of our culture. Through topic communities, expert colleagues, and our internal academy, GAIN, you'll have plenty of opportunities to develop your skills in areas such as Agentic AI, Data Strategy, AI Product Development, and Technology Platforms, while helping clients achieve measurable results.

Join a team that loves learning, solving challenges together, and having fun along the way. Ready to join the ride?

Where you’ll make a difference

  • Drive data & AI projects forward – analyze data, build models, and deliver insights that create real business impact

  • Apply cutting-edge machine learning techniques – solve complex, real-world problems with innovative approaches

  • Develop algorithmic solutions – take ownership of your work and help transform high-impact business processes

  • Contribute to organizational change – implement data & AI innovations supported by GAIN®, our certified education and training portfolio

  • Use technical expertise and communication skills – build scalable data & AI solutions that drive value across the organization

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams – contribute from day one while learning from experienced leaders

What makes us the right choice for you

  • Be part of groundbreaking change as we scale a business in a fast-evolving industry with a dedicated international growth strategy, a team of experts, and the support of an experienced investor

  • Step into a role where you contribute ideas, support innovation, and help shape how organizations use data & AI to create real impact

  • Deepen your skills in data & AI – gain exposure to diverse industries, tackle real-world challenges, and grow through hands-on projects and expert mentorship in a future-focused environment

  • Join a vibrant, multidisciplinary team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and just the right amount of nerdy – where learning and laughter go hand in hand

  • Work alongside clients as a valued team member – building relationships based on trust, shared goals, and face-to-face collaboration whenever it matters most

  • Thrive in a culture that values autonomy, curiosity, and bold thinking – where your voice matters, ideas turn into action, and your impact is genuinely recognized and rewarded


What makes you shine

You’re a motivated problem solver and a curious learner – with a passion for turning data & AI into real business impact. You’ll thrive with us if you bring:

  • A Master’s degree with excellent results in a quantitative or STEM field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics)

  • Practical experience through internships, projects, or research – demonstrating your ability to work with data, build models, and extract actionable insights

  • A hands-on, growth mindset – you take ownership of your tasks, embrace challenges, and contribute to solutions that create real value

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative spirit – you enjoy working in teams, explaining technical concepts clearly, and supporting a positive, inclusive work environment

  • Sharp analytical and technical skills – you excel at both problem-solving and implementing solutions that bridge business and technology

  • Fluency in both English and German (written and spoken), and willingness to travel regularly to client sites

If you're hesitating because you don't meet every requirement, don't let that hold you back. Strong candidates often underestimate how well they fit a role. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply!

Where you’ll work

Many projects require working onsite at client locations throughout Germany (and occasionally Europe) for several days per week. Travel requirements vary depending on the project and client needs.

While our main office is located in Heidelberg, many of our team members are based across various cities in Germany. This reflects our flexible and distributed team structure, which means that relocation is not required.
At the same time, as we continue to grow our Heidelberg office, being located within reasonable travel distance is an advantage and helps facilitate collaboration.

In their own words

“At Rewire, I have the opportunity to learn how to translate my theoretical knowledge into impactful applications across multiple industries and purposes. It is always exciting to engage in stimulating conversations with my colleagues and gain exposure to different analytical perspectives on how to tackle the same problem!” – Alex Lucchini, Data Scientist at Rewire

 

Sound like your kind of team?

Perfect! If you’re ready to kick-start your career and want to make real impact with data & AI, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now! And let’s see where this journey takes us.

Questions? Feel free to ask them via ----- – we’re happy to chat.

 

Who you are matters to us!

We welcome all applicants – regardless of gender, background, or LGBT+ identity – because diversity and inclusion are core values for us. We are convinced that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and success. 

We believe diverse teams build better solutions. We are committed to building a more diverse engineering team and particularly encourage women and other underrepresented groups in technology to apply.

description_html:
Van de Velde ist ein international erfolgreiches Unternehmen mit über 100 Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Produktion hochwertiger Lingerie‑Marken wie Marie Jo, PrimaDonna und Sarda. Werden Sie Teil eines passionierten und professionellen Teams von mehr als 1.500 Kolleginnen und Kollegen weltweit. Seit über 25 Jahren ist Van de Velde börsennotiert und wächst kontinuierlich weiter – mit Innovationskraft und Leidenschaft für Premium‑Lingerie.

Unsere Mission: We ignite the power in women.

Bei Van de Velde stehen unsere Mitarbeiter seit jeher im Mittelpunkt. Wir glauben fest an die Stärke und das Potenzial jedes Einzelnen – und insbesondere an die Kraft der Frauen. Diese Überzeugung prägt unseren Umgang mit unseren Mitarbeitern, Kunde*innen, Konsument*innen und Frauen in der Gesellschaft.

Wir stehen für Leidenschaft, Qualität, Authentizität, Kundenorientierung, unternehmerisches Denken und Teamgeist. Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Werte teilt und unsere Marken in Süddeutschland weiter voranbringt.

Wir handeln mit Leidenschaft | Wir leben Qualität | Wir sind authentisch | Wir fokussieren uns auf Konsumentinnen und Kundinnen* | Wir sind unternehmerisch | Gemeinsam sind wir stärker.


Für eine befristete Anstellung von ca. 18 Monaten suchen wir eine/einen engagierte/n und kommerziell orientierte/n Retail Trainer/in für die Region Süddeutschland (München als zentraler Standort dieser Region).

In dieser Rolle werden Sie zur Trainingsexpertin bzw. zum Trainingsexperten und Markenbotschafter/in für unsere Produkte, Kollektionen und unsere Passform-Expertise in Warenhäusern, bei Handelspartnern und auf Events in Ihrer Region. Sie spielen eine zentrale Rolle dabei, sowohl Verkaufsteams als auch Konsumentinnen zu inspirieren und das Kundenerlebnis im Store sowie die Verkaufsleistung zu verbessern.

Dies ist eine sehr dynamische Außendienstposition mit sehr häufigen Reisen innerhalb Deutschlands, insbesondere in Süddeutschland rund um München (dies ist der ideale, aber nicht zwingende Wohnsitz für diese Rolle). Sie werden regelmäßig mehrere Tage unterwegs sein, um Kundinnen und Kunden zu besuchen, Stores zu unterstützen und Trainings durchzuführen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von ansprechenden Produkt- und Passformtrainings für Handelspartner, Warenhäuser und Verkaufspersonal in ganz Deutschland

  • Organisation und Durchführung von Trainingssessions, Events, Classroom-Trainings und Webinaren

  • Schulung von Store-Mitarbeitern*innen zu Kollektionen, Produkt-USPs, Passform-Expertise und Kundenerlebnis

  • Unterstützung von Retail-Teams und Konsumentinnen mit Produktwissen und Styling-Beratung

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsteam sowie gegenseitiger Austausch von Feedback zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Leistung und Kundenerlebnis

  • Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu Warenhäusern und Handelspartnern durch regelmäßige Besuche vor Ort

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktentwicklung und internen Stakeholdern, um Produktwissen in wirkungsvolle Trainings zu übersetzen

  • Entwicklung neuer Trainingsmodule und -materialien auf kreative und praxisnahe Weise

  • Schneller Aufbau umfassender Produktkenntnisse in den ersten Monaten der Tätigkeit

Sie werden Teil eines eng verbundenen internationalen Trainingsteams, bei dem Zusammenarbeit, Coaching und Wissensaustausch im Mittelpunkt stehen. Obwohl das Team überwiegend remote arbeitet und viel reist, besteht ein täglicher Austausch und starke gegenseitige Unterstützung.

Ihr Profil

  • Erfahrung in Training, Coaching, Retail, Vertriebsunterstützung oder einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Position

  • Erfahrung in Mode, Lingerie, Textil oder Premium-Retail ist ein großer Vorteil, Leidenschaft ist ein Muss

  • Sie begeistern sich für Produktschulungen und inspirieren gerne Menschen

  • Sie kombinieren starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit einer kommerziellen Denkweise

  • Sie sind sehr gut organisiert und können Planung, Reisen und verschiedene Stakeholder gut managen

  • Sie treten sicher vor Gruppen auf und passen Ihre Kommunikation flexibel an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen an

  • Sie arbeiten gerne unterwegs und selbstständig

  • Sie sind proaktiv, lernbereit und können konstruktiv Feedback geben

  • Sie interessieren sich stark für Passform, Styling und ein optimales Kundenerlebnis

  • Eine praxisorientierte, bescheidene und teamorientierte Einstellung ist essenziell

Sprachkenntnisse

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch sind erforderlich

  • Bewerbungen und Kommunikation für diese Position erfolgen auf Englisch

Praktische Informationen

  • Befristete Anstellung von ca. 1,5 Jahren

  • Häufige Reisen innerhalb Deutschlands (hauptsächlich Süddeutschland)

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und Autonomie

  • Homeoffice-basiert, wenn nicht auf Reisen

  • Besuche in Belgien für Kollektionen und Produktschulungen erforderlich

Was wir bieten

  • Einen befristeten Vertrag in einem stabilen, internationalen und börsennotierten Modeunternehmen mit einer positiven Unternehmenskultur, die Initiative und neue Ideen fördert

  • Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket ergänzt durch zusätzliche Benefits

  • Einen Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung inklusive Tankkarte

  • Ein umfassendes Onboarding-Programm sowie kontinuierliche Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung

description_html:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About the Role

We are seeking a Foundational Machine Learning Engineer for a high-impact greenfield opportunity to build our MLOps infrastructure from the ground up at Vestiaire Collective. While driving our AI authentication initiatives (deploying multi-model approaches including computer vision for luxury product authentication and counterfeit detection) will be your immediate focus, your long-term mission will be to scale foundational architecture across the entire marketplace. You will expand our ML capabilities to power broader domains, primarily focusing on search and recommendation systems, with future expansions into dynamic pricing and marketing technologies. Acting as the bridge among Applied Science, Data Platform, and Backend Engineering, you will design robust, decoupled architectures and spearhead the MLOps strategy with our Director of Data, prioritizing system maintainability, engineering hygiene, and the reliable deployment of complex models, ensuring all our ML models across the board deliver high-throughput, low-latency business impact.

What You Will Do

  • Short-Term Impact (First 6 Months): Partner closely with the Operations squads and Data Scientists to accelerate ML and RAG prototypes into resilient, production-ready code. You will directly integrate with the team to deploy, optimize, and scale heavy-width CV and VLM models focused on fraud detection and luxury product authentication, immediately improving our trust and safety ecosystem.

  • Mid-Term Foundation (MLOps Lifecycle & Infrastructure): Lead the end-to-end foundational groundwork of our ML lifecycle by designing robust systems for Data & Feature Management, Model Tracking & Registry, and Model Serving & Monitoring. You will scale infrastructure by automating continuous retraining pipelines that handle diverse deployment cadences (from daily fraud detection to weekly recommendations), design resilient multi-model architectures, and critically evaluate the technical overhead and TCO of our in-house tools against enterprise-grade platforms to ensure long-term resilience.

  • Long-Term Vision (Centralizing 360-Degree MLE Capabilities): Act as a pioneer and cornerstone hire for the ML engineering discipline at Vestiaire Collective, setting the technical standards to help scale the AI/ML organization. You will transition into a centralized foundational role, moving beyond single-squad operations to mentor the team and provide horizontal ML infrastructure support to multiple domains, including Search, Discovery, Pricing, Marketing, and Data Platforms.

Who You Are

Must-Haves:

  • Experience: 5-8+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning Engineering, specifically focused on building and scaling MLOps infrastructure and productionizing ML systems.

  • Production Infrastructure: Proven expertise in deploying low-latency, high-throughput ML inference services (using FastAPI, TorchServe, Triton Inference Server, or Ray Serve) across both classical lightweight and heavy-width ML models (PyTorch/TensorFlow). Strong preference for AWS (EKS, EC2, SageMaker) / Snowflake and Open Source ecosystems over GCP/Azure.

  • MLOps & Pipelines: Deep experience building automated, continuous model retraining pipelines to handle concept drift (ranging from daily to weekly cycles). You have orchestrated decoupled, multi-model AI architectures using tools like Airflow, Kubeflow, or Metaflow, and possess strong expertise in model registry and tracking tools like MLflow or Weights & Biases.

  • Feature Stores: Hands-on experience evaluating, building, or extensively leveraging online (Redis, DynamoDB) and offline (Snowflake, S3) Feature Stores in a production environment. Familiarity with frameworks like Feast or custom dbt-based pipelines is highly valued.

  • Strategic Builder Mindset: You are an analytical builder who thinks long-term. You can successfully evaluate TCO for bespoke internal systems versus enterprise tools, anticipate technical liabilities, and design robust architectures that handle unpredictable peak traffic surges.

  • Collaboration & Engineering Hygiene: Strong cross-functional communication skills. You excel at translating complex ML prototypes into highly scalable production code backed by strict version control, rigorous testing, and CI/CD best practices, seamlessly connecting data science innovation with backend engineering execution.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Relevant Domain Expertise: Background in E-commerce, Single-SKU Marketplaces, Search & Recommendation, Trust & Safety, or Counterfeit Detection.

  • Vision, Edge & Optimization: Hands-on experience with Vector Databases, Visual RAG pipelines, deploying Deep Learning VLM models, and optimizing models for edge computing or low-latency inference (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT).

Infrastructure & Observability: Advanced experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and data transformation workflows (dbt). Familiarity with setting up advanced monitoring for model performance, concept drift, and system health (Datadog, Prometheus).
What we offer 🎁

A meaningful job with an impact on the way people consume fashion and promote sustainability
The opportunity to do career-defining work in a fast-growing French-born scale up
The possibility to work as part of a globally diverse team with more than 50 nationalities 
Two days to help Project - reinforcing your activist journey and volunteer for an association
Significant investment in your learning and growth
Competitive compensation and benefits package (i.e 28 days of paid time off)

description_html:
Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn. Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig.

Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. Mit ausgeprägter Abschlussstärke und einem klaren Gespür für Chancen schaffst du stabile Umsatzströme und nachhaltige Partnerschaften.

📍Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit Sitz in Düsseldorf (oder Stuttgart) und einem flexiblen hybriden Arbeitsmodell.


Was Du machst:

  • Du treibst den aktiven Vertrieb der Caseware-Lösungen voran, führst beratungsorientierte Gespräche, präsentierst Produkte überzeugend und steuerst den gesamten Sales Cycle souverän. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Marketing, Consulting und Product Management zusammen.

  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter, indem du die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Ansprechpartner genau verstehst.

  • Du erhöhst den Marktanteil und den ARR in deinem Gebiet, indem du neue Kunden gewinnst, Abschlüsse verlässlich zum Erfolg führst und bestehende Accounts durch Up- und Cross-Selling ausbaust.

  • Du entwickelst strategische Vertriebs- und Account-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um. Dabei nutzt du bereichsübergreifende Ressourcen gezielt, um Umsatzpotenziale zu erschließen und Verkaufschancen erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu bringen.

  • Du steuerst deine Pipeline strukturiert und diszipliniert und lieferst präzise Forecasts, die klare Entscheidungen ermöglichen und eine verlässliche Entwicklung in Richtung der Vertriebsziele unterstützen.

  • Du stärkst die Marktpräsenz von Caseware und baust dein professionelles Netzwerk aktiv aus, indem du mit wichtigen Entscheidern und relevanten Branchenkontakten im Austausch bist.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Kundendaten und Vertragsdetails vollständig und korrekt im CRM dokumentiert sind, damit Transparenz und effiziente Abläufe jederzeit gewährleistet sind.


    • Was Du mitbringst:

  • Du kommunizierst überzeugend, trittst souverän auf und schaffst es, schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern aufzubauen.

  • Du hast nachweislich Erfolge in der Gewinnung von Neukunden und im strategischen Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen erzielt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb mit und hast Vertriebsziele eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und erreicht.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung und schaffst damit die Grundlage für nachhaltige Kundenpartnerschaften.

  • Du gehst mit Neugier, Motivation und einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Haltung auf Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen zu.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für vertriebliche Potenziale und verstehst, wie sich Kundenbedürfnisse in konkreten Mehrwert übersetzen lassen.

  • Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Audit, Finance oder Accounting sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

    • Was wir Dir bieten:
    • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybrid-Setup: Klare Mischung aus Präsenz- und Remote-Arbeit, gemeinsam definierte Kernzeiten und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung im Arbeitsalltag.
     • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt mit variablen Bestandteilen, ergänzt durch globale und lokale Benefits sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
     • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld: Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen, Englisch als Arbeitssprache und verlässliche, strukturierte Abstimmung über Teams hinweg.
    • Sinnstiftendes Produkt mit Kund:innen-Impact: Caseware unterstützt Organisationen dabei, Audit- und Financial-Reporting-Prozesse effizienter und verlässlicher zu gestalten, mit Cloud- und KI-gestützten Lösungen.
     • Verantwortung und Entwicklung im Job: Du übernimmst Ownership für relevante Themen, bringst Ideen aktiv ein und entwickelst dich innerhalb der Rolle sowie perspektivisch im Unternehmen weiter, fachlich oder in Richtung Führung.
     • Healthcare & Wellbeing: Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellbeing-Leistungen für dich und deine Familie, orientiert an lokalen Standards.

    Über Caseware:
    Caseware entwickelt Software für Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen. Unsere Teams arbeiten eng zusammen, verbessern bestehende Lösungen und entwickeln neue Produkte, die auf die Anforderungen der Zukunft ausgerichtet sind. Mit der Investition von Hg Capital im Jahr 2020 haben wir eine wichtige Wachstumsphase begonnen, in der wir konsequent in Menschen, Produkte und Strukturen investieren. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt sind uns wichtig. Wir möchten Teams aufbauen, die unterschiedliche Hintergründe und Perspektiven einbringen. Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wenn du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung benötigst, kannst du uns jederzeit unter ----- kontaktieren.

    Sicherheitshinweis:
    Kommunikation von Caseware erfolgt ausschließlich über E-Mail-Adressen, die auf ----- enden. Alle offenen Stellen findest du auf anerkannten Jobportalen und unter
    https://jobs.lever.co/caseware
    Wir fragen niemals nach Zahlungen oder finanziellen Angaben. Wenn dir ein verdächtiges Angebot zugesendet wird, sei vorsichtig.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio und AI Solutions Consultant (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Skaylink
description_html:
Als Microsoft Copilot Studio und AI Solutions Consultant (m/w/d) entwickelst du intelligente und skalierbare KI Lösungen für unsere Kunden.
 
Du begleitest wertvolle Anwendungsfälle von der ersten Idee über Prototyp und Pilot bis in den sicheren produktiven Betrieb. Im Zentrum stehen Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services sowie die Integration von Unternehmensdaten, Prozessen und bestehenden Plattformen.

Was du bei uns machst
• Konzeption, Entwicklung und Betrieb intelligenter Agenten und Multi Agent Lösungen mit Microsoft Copilot Studio.
• Design und Implementierung generativer KI Lösungen mit Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI und weiteren Azure AI Services.
• Entwicklung passender Lösungsarchitekturen einschließlich Orchestrierung, Retrieval Augmented Generation und Anbindung von Unternehmensdaten.
• Integration von Connectors, APIs, Microsoft 365, Power Platform und weiteren Unternehmenssystemen.
• Durchführung technischer Discovery Workshops sowie Umsetzung von Prototypen, Proof of Value, Pilotprojekten und produktionsreifen Lösungen.
• Mitgestaltung unseres Agent as a Service Angebots sowie Beratung zu Sicherheit, Governance, Responsible AI, Betrieb und Skalierung.

Wann du zu uns passt
• Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Agenten mit Microsoft Copilot Studio und idealerweise in der Umsetzung von Multi Agent Szenarien.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services oder vergleichbaren Plattformen für generative KI.
• Technisches Verständnis für Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering, Orchestrierung, Retrieval Augmented Generation und Datenintegration.
• Erfahrung mit Power Platform, Connectors, REST APIs, Automatisierung und Enterprise Architekturen.
• Kenntnisse zu Sicherheit, Governance, Datenschutz, Compliance und verantwortungsvoller KI im Unternehmenskontext.
• Teamfähigkeit, Freude an Innovation und sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch.
• Eine oder mehrere passende Microsoft Zertifizierungen, zum Beispiel AI-900, AI-102, AB-100, AB-620 oder AB-730, oder die Bereitschaft, diese zeitnah zu erwerben.
Hey, wir sind Skaylink.
Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!
 

Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien. 

Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen. 

Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst. 

Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig. 

 
Was du von uns hast
 
🎯 Purpose – Deine Expertise einsetzen (in Projekten bei re­nom­mierten Unternehmen wie BMW Group, Henkel oder KWS)
🌍 Flexibilität – Deine Balance finden (u. a. Workation, Urlaubsflexibilisierung) 
📖 Entwicklung – Ankommen und Weiterkommen (u. a. Skaylink Campus, Entwicklungsgespräche, regelmäßige Befragungen der Mitarbeitenden)
🏖️ Erholung – Kraft tanken (u. a. 30 Tage Urlaub, 24. + 31.12 frei, Sabbatical) 
🚲 Mobilität – Von A nach B kommen (u. a. BusinessBike, Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket)  
💻 Ausstattung – Die Qual der Wahl (Apple/Windows, Firmenhandy) 
💪 Unterstützung – Fühl dich wohl (u. a. Employee Referral Program, Corporate Benefits, Arbeitsplatzbrille, jährlich 5 bezahlte Kind-krank-Tage) 
🏆 Events – Zusammenkommen und Feiern (u. a. Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeier, Teamevents, Cross-Company Tech-Talks) 
🧩 Miteinander – We are Skaylink! 
 
Du + Skaylink = Perfect Match? 
 
Dann bewirb dich – auch falls du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst! Wir benötigen nur deinen Lebenslauf und sind schon ganz gespannt darauf, von dir zu lesen. 
 
Wir freuen uns auf die gemeinsame (Cloud) Journey mit dir!

title: Technical Project Manager (all genders) - Retail and window campaigns
description_html:
JOIN US

We are currently looking for a Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our team at our Stuttgart location. With your enthusiasm, you will support our sophisticated retail and window campaigns, ensuring that projects are successfully implemented.

Become part of our community – we look forward to meeting you!


WHAT YOU DO

  • As a Technical Project Manager (all genders), you steer high-end window campaigns with high quality and aesthetic standards for our client in the luxury sector.
  • You serve as the primary point of contact for our clients regarding technical queries and act as the interface between internal design and specialist departments, prototyping, production, and external logistics partners.
  • With a keen eye for budgets and processes, you maintain an overview across all project phases, ensuring campaigns are completed successfully, on schedule, and profitably.
  • You contribute your technical expertise to material selection and review technical drawings for their feasibility.
  • You are responsible for quality gates in production, manage prototyping, VM, and pre-assembly approvals, and oversee the final on-site installation of window campaigns (within Germany).


WHO YOU ARE

  • You bring at least 3 years of professional experience in project management, ideally with a focus on technical campaigns, prototyping, and production.
  • You have a strong technical understanding as well as sound knowledge of materials, and you can read 3D visualizations and technical drawings to translate them into execution.
  • You possess very good knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint); experience with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills in German and English, enjoyment of direct client interaction, and motivation to support on-site installations.
  • You work independently, structurally, and responsibly with high quality standards, as well as an interest in fashion, innovation, sustainability, and craftsmanship.


WHAT TO EXPECT

  • DIVERSITY & PEOPLE: Come as you are! At LIGANOVA, a culture of inclusion is lived and breathed, and diversity fascinates us. Uniqueness is celebrated and encouraged, which is why we are united by our shared mission: “Create the best version of yourself.” Because we believe that diversity holds the greatest creative potential.
  • GREEN MINDSET: Innovative solutions and our Green Board drive greater sustainability both in the office and beyond. Through our Green Campaign Cycle initiative, we proactively introduce our clients to the topic of green transformation and support them during implementation with our expertise.
  • INTERNATIONALITY: In addition to our headquarters in Stuttgart, our offices in Berlin and Amsterdam have also grown into full-fledged branches. We offer you networking opportunities and regular exchange across units, far removed from rigid team structures.

description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Pflege, Konfiguration und Erweiterung unserer operativen Systeme (ZohoCRM, Desk, Books, Signund angrenzende Tools)
  • Entwicklung von Automationen und Business-Logik mit Deluge, Python und JavaScript: Workflows, Functions, Client-Skripte und geplante Jobs
  • Entwicklung und Verbesserung LLM-gestützter Lösungen: Du baust KI-Agenten und Automationen auf Basis von Large Language Models, entwickelst und testest Prompts, pflegst die zugrunde liegenden Wissensbasen und Trainingsdaten und misst systematisch, ob die Ergebnisse besser werden
  • Design und Implementierung von Datenaustausch zwischen Systemen via REST-APIs, Webhooks und Automationsplattformen
  • Debugging von Integrationen und Behebung von Data-Quality-Issues: Logs lesen, API-Calls nachverfolgen, Ursachen finden und sauber beheben
  • Unterstützung interner Stakeholder: Prozessanforderungen in funktionierende, wartbare Lösungen übersetzen
  • Dokumentation deiner Lösungen, damit sie für andere und dich selbst nachvollziehbar bleiben
  • Mitarbeit an Frontend-/UI-Themen im Rahmen der CRM-Oberfläche


Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (oder kurz vor Abschluss) in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, einer technischen Fachrichtung oder vergleichbar
  • Interesse an KI- und LLM-Themen und Lust, damit praktisch zu arbeiten
  • Solide Grundlagen in mindestens einer Skriptsprache (z. B. JavaScript oder Python) 
  • Verständnis dafür, wie REST-APIs funktionieren: HTTP-Methoden, Statuscodes, JSON, Authentifizierung (z. B. API-Keys, OAuth2-Grundlagen)
  • Grundkenntnisse relationaler Datenmodelle und wie Geschäftsdaten strukturiert sind
  • Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise mit echtem Blick fürs Detail
  • Hohe Lernbereitschaft, Neugier und Agilität bei Veränderungen
  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Offenheit, früh Fragen zu stellen
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens B2-Niveau
  • Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Zoho-Produkten (CRM, Desk, Books, Creator, Flow), Low-Code-Tools (Make,Zapier, n8n),Git, SQL oder SSO-Konzepten


Warum wir?

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du ermöglichst barrierefreies Wohnen für Menschen mit eingeschränkter Mobilität – und leistest so jeden Tag einen echten gesellschaftlichen Beitrag
  • Echter Teamgeist: Wir arbeiten nicht nur zusammen, wir halten zusammen. Dich erwartet ein offenes, unterstützendes Team auf Augenhöhe
  • Mobilität & Benefits: Wähle flexibel zwischen dem Deutschlandticket, einem JobRad (nach der Probezeit) oder einer Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft
  • Flexibilität: Nutze nach der Probezeit die Möglichkeit zur Workation von anderen Orten aus
  • Mehr als nur Gehalt: Profitiere von attraktiven Corporate Benefits und unserem freiwilligen HORNBACH-Mitarbeiteraktienprogramm
  • Wohlfühl-Office: Dich erwartet ein modernes Büro mit kostenlosen Snacks und Getränken, einer großen Küche und regelmäßigen Team-Events

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Samsara
description_html:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will: 

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. 
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
