title: Technical Project Manager - Engineering Delivery
description_html:
Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution.

You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions.

We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering.

The role

Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams, working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives.

This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution. You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization.

Process ownership

You will own and continuously improve:

  • engineering delivery planning processes
  • delivery tracking and reporting
  • cross-team coordination and dependency management.

You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop.

Delivery execution

Day to day, you will:

  • track delivery across teams and releases
  • coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams
  • identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early
  • challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments
  • coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk
  • provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment.

The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective.

What success looks like

First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery.

Within ~6-8 weeks: You understand the roadmap, teams, dependencies and delivery processes well enough to manage them confidently and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

Within 3 months: You operate autonomously across day-to-day engineering delivery coordination, bringing in the Head of Software Engineering when decisions or trade-offs require escalation.

Your work will directly influence our delivery efficiency and predictability: how much we can take on and how reliably we deliver what we commit to.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership, for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager.

Titles matter less than scope. You need enough technical depth to understand architecture and dependencies, ask the right questions, and navigate complex delivery problems across teams.

We expect

  • around 10 years of experience in software engineering environments
  • at least 3 years in engineering or technical leadership
  • previous hands-on experience as a software engineer
  • experience leading or coordinating multiple engineering teams
  • a track record of delivering complex software initiatives and improving execution
  • strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, distributed systems and cross-team dependencies
  • understanding of Product Management fundamentals
  • experience with Agile and structured project management frameworks such as PMBOK or similar
  • strong prioritization, decision-making and communication skills
  • professional fluency in English.

French and Russian are nice to have.

This role will suit you if…

You still enjoy technical complexity, but what really motivates you is making execution work.

You like finding out why something is stuck and fixing it.

You genuinely enjoy the operational side of engineering: creating structure, improving processes, coordinating teams and making sure things get delivered.

You don’t just want to follow an established process. You naturally look for ways to make it work better.

You are comfortable working across multiple teams, asking difficult questions when needed, and bringing structure to situations where priorities, dependencies or timelines are not immediately clear.

Why Diabolocom

Diabolocom is building one of Europe’s most advanced AI-native CCaaS platforms, powering business-critical customer interactions for 400+ enterprise and mid-market customers across 60+ countries.

We combine a mature global CCaaS platform with a rapidly growing AI Product Suite, backed by our internal AI Research Lab and proprietary AI innovation.

Our ambition goes beyond adding AI features to an existing product. We are building toward a platform capable of orchestrating AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels, with CCaaS as the execution layer.

For Engineering, this means working on the technical and operational challenges of an established enterprise product, from real-time communications and distributed systems to complex integrations, while contributing to its next generation.

With teams across Europe, the US, Brazil and the UAE, and an engineering organization of around 90 people, this role offers the opportunity to work on engineering delivery behind a global product used for critical customer operations.

Why this role

This is a hands-on role combining delivery execution with process ownership.

You will work with the Head of Software Engineering, Team Leads, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams, with a broad view of engineering delivery across the organization.

You will inherit established delivery practices, own them, and continuously improve how we plan, coordinate and track execution.

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition
  2. Interview with the Head of Software Engineering
  3. Interview with the CTO
  4. Interview with the Head of Product

Logistics

📍 Paris, France
🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽 Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed
🏠 Relocation support available

title: Responsable Comptable
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Diabolocom
description_html:
Créée en 2005, Diabolocom est une entreprise technologique 100 % autofinancée et sans dette, comptant aujourd’hui environ 250 collaborateurs. Nous nous sommes développés par une croissance saine, rentable et maîtrisée. Nous construisons une entreprise indépendante, robuste et internationale, conçue pour durer. La qualité de nos solutions et la maîtrise de nos infrastructures souveraines nous permettent aujourd’hui de remporter des appels d’offres majeurs auprès de grands comptes. Ces succès sécurisent le doublement de notre chiffre d’affaires à horizon 2 ans et nous donnent une trajectoire claire vers un quadruplement à 4 ans.

 

Solidement implantés en Europe, nous avons accéléré notre développement international avec l’ouverture de bureaux aux États-Unis, au Canada, au Brésil et aux Emirats Arabes Unis, et poursuivons la construction d’une présence mondiale durable.

Nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : passer d’une logique de « build » à une logique de « scale ».

Notre ambition est claire : bâtir un acteur technologique mondial, solide financièrement, exigeant opérationnellement et durable stratégiquement.

 

C’est pour accompagner cette trajectoire que nous recrutons notre Responsable Comptable rattaché.e au DAF, dans le cadre d'un remplacement et d'une phase de structuration de la fonction comptable. 

 

Responsabilités principales

 

Production comptable & clôtures

  • Superviser l'ensemble des opérations comptables : saisie, révision, comptabilité générale et analytique

  • Garantir la fiabilité des comptes et le respect des normes françaises en vigueur

  • Piloter et produire les clôtures mensuelles dans les délais (cut-off, provisions, écritures)

  • Coordonner la clôture annuelle : justification des comptes, établissement du bilan

  • Établir les déclarations fiscales et assurer la conformité réglementaire

  • Gérer la relation avec les partenaires externes : Expert-Comptable (interlocuteur facilitant), commissaires aux comptes, banques

 

Périmètre & interlocuteurs

  • Travailler en transverse avec le Légal, la Direction Générale, les Sales, et l’Account Management…

  • Gérer plusieurs entités (filiales) dans différents pays : un vrai plus si expérience multi-entités

 

Outillage & projets structurants

  • Outils clés : ZUORA (facturation), Salesforce (CRM), ERP SAP (en cours de déploiement/reconfiguration)

  • Participer activement à la mise en œuvre de la réforme de la facturation électronique

  • Contribuer à la réflexion sur la stack d'outils comptables et leur évolution

 

Management & construction d'équipe

  • Construire progressivement l'équipe comptable en lien avec le DAF

  • Structurer les process, documenter les bonnes pratiques, garantir les délais

  • Faire monter en compétences les futur·es collaborateur·ices recruté·es

 

Profil recherché

 

Formation & expérience

  • Bac +3 minimum en comptabilité/finance (DCG, DSCG, licence CCA ou équivalent)

  • 5 à 7 ans d'expérience en comptabilité générale

  • Expérience multi-entités (filiales) : un atout fort

  • Première expérience de management d'une petite équipe (1 à 3 personnes)

 

Compétences techniques

  • Solide expertise des normes comptables et fiscales françaises

  • Expérience avérée, capacité à les piloter seul·e dans un premier temps

  • Must-have. Expérience ERP (SAP idéalement, ou autre ERP structuré)

  • Outils SaaS de facturation/CRM (ex. ZUORA, Salesforce) : un plus apprécié

  • Niveau B1/B2 à l'écrit et à l'oral, principalement pour les échanges internes – niveau opérationnel attendu

  • Pack Office / Excel 

 

Qualités personnelles 

  • Builder & hands-on

  • Débrouillard·e & pragmatique

  • Curieux·se sur les outils et l'IA

  • Autonome & force de proposition

  • Bon·ne communiquant·e

  • Rigueur & fiabilité

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre 

  • Rejoindre une scale-up en forte croissance à un moment clé de son développement, avec de réelles perspectives d'évolution.

  • Bénéficier d'une véritable autonomie pour construire, structurer et faire évoluer votre périmètre.

  • Avoir l'opportunité de constituer votre propre équipe à moyen terme.

  • Participer à des projets de transformation stratégiques (ERP, facturation électronique, optimisation des outils) dans un environnement technologique moderne.

  • Évoluer au sein d'une équipe Finance accessible, pragmatique et orientée résultats, avec une forte proximité avec les métiers.

  • Travailler dans un environnement international réunissant plus de 10 nationalités.

  • Choisir votre équipement de travail (Mac ou PC) selon vos préférences.

  • Profiter d'une organisation flexible, avec 2 jours de télétravail par semaine.

  • Partager des moments de convivialité grâce à nos afterworks, événements d'équipe et séminaires (Porquerolles, Corse, Marrakech, Djerba...).

  • Travailler dans des bureaux idéalement situés à Opéra, rue de la Paix (Paris 2ᵉ).



Processus de recrutement

 

  • Visio avec Déborah (Talent Acquisition Manager)

  • Entretien avec Alexis (CFO) 

  • Entretien avec l'Expert-Comptable

At Diabolocom, diversity and inclusion are in our DNA. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to color, language, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or social origin, opinion disability, age.

 

As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer or service provider offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history.

title: Head of Infrastructure
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Diabolocom
description_html:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.
  • AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.
  • Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission

Your goal is to make infrastructure ready for the next stage of scaling up by building a strong operational foundation across all the infrastructure domains.

You will:

  • Own infrastructure reliability and operations across the whole stack: incident management, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems and prevention of recurring failures.
  • Improve operational visibility across infrastructure teams: identify bottlenecks, improve processes and drive continuous improvements.
  • Improve capacity planning processes, connecting business growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Lead the evolution of our network and telecom infrastructure: topology, connectivity, carrier relationships, routing, redundancy and voice platform performance and reliability.
  • Own our on-premise infrastructure operations: data centers, hardware, storage, connectivity and deployment practices.
  • Drive scalability and reliability of our stateful infrastructure: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis and other critical systems.
  • Support the evolution of our AI infrastructure, including GPU workloads and compute clusters.
  • Drive infrastructure improvements with automation, observability and tooling.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure applications run reliably on our platforms.
  • Lead and grow the Infrastructure team across Networking, SRE, Stateful Systems, Voice, and Data Center squads.

Who we are looking for

We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain.

We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership.

You might be:

  • a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge;
  • an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering;
  • a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title;
  • a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership.

Must Have

  • Deep expertise in at least 2–3 infrastructure domains, such as:
    • networking;
    • SRE/reliability;
    • database administration;
    • telecom/voice infrastructure;
    • hardware/on-premise infrastructure.
  • Proven experience building and improving infrastructure operations: establishing processes, improving reliability practices, driving incident management and creating effective ways of working across multiple infrastructure domains.
  • Experience leading technical teams where different groups own different areas of infrastructure (for example networking, SRE, databases, systems or platform engineering).
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you stay close to technology, understand technical details and lead through context and expertise.
  • Self-taught, hands-on background — you have grown technically by solving complex problems beyond your formal role.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work onsite in Paris.

Nice to Have

Experience with:

  • Telecom or carrier infrastructure.
  • Voice platforms or real-time communication systems.
  • PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ or Redis operational experience at scale.
  • Dark fiber, peering and advanced networking.
  • Kubernetes in production.
  • GPU infrastructure.
  • Incident command and post-mortem culture.

About You

You are motivated by complexity and ownership, not titles.

You solve problems before being asked.

You are comfortable with ambiguity — infrastructure is complex, and you know how to make pragmatic technical trade-offs.

You enjoy building teams and scaling impact through people, not only systems.

You stay curious about networking, hardware trends, observability and modern infrastructure practices.

Why join us

Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact.

Your work will directly influence reliability, customer experience and engineering velocity.

Work on infrastructure that cannot simply be outsourced.

From telecom networks and hardware to distributed systems and AI workloads, you will solve problems where architecture and engineering decisions matter.

Build something from an early stage of maturity.

You will help establish the operational discipline, processes and team structure needed for the next phase of growth.

Work directly with technical leadership.

You will report directly to Sergey, our CTO, who is deeply involved in infrastructure and technical decisions while giving infrastructure leaders the ownership to drive changes.

Recruitment Process

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition
    Up to 1h — alignment on experience, expectations and motivation.

  2. Two technical conversations with Sergey, CTO
    Focused on:

  • infrastructure strategy;
  • technical depth;
  • architecture decisions;
  • operational leadership approach.

  1. Meeting with the infrastructure team
    Onsite or online session focused on collaboration, problem-solving and engineering culture.

  2. Final conversation with CEO

Logistics

📍 Paris, France
🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽 Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed
🏠 Relocation support available

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already done this exact role in this exact environment.

The strongest candidates are often engineers who grew into leadership by taking ownership, solving complex problems and going beyond their formal responsibilities.

If you have built and operated complex infrastructure, enjoy solving ambiguous technical challenges and want to shape a critical engineering domain — we would love to talk.

title: Regional Marketing Intern
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Deliverect
description_html:
At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.

Deliverect

En tant que licorne mondiale du SaaS en pleine expansion, Deliverect est à l’avant-garde de la révolution des solutions technologiques destinées aux secteurs dynamiques de l’hôtellerie-restauration et du « Q-commerce ».
Notre mission est claire : donner aux personnes ambitieuses les compétences et les connaissances nécessaires pour avoir un impact positif sur l’entreprise. Elles peuvent ainsi évoluer dans leur carrière tout en s’inscrivant dans un projet qui les dépasse.

Department Focus

Entrez dans l'univers du service marketing de Deliverect : une équipe dynamique composée de professionnels créatifs, axés sur les données et orientés vers les résultats, qui se consacrent corps et âme à la mission de Deliverect : donner aux entreprises les moyens d'offrir une expérience de commande exceptionnelle.
Nous ne nous contentons pas de placer les clients au cœur de nos stratégies ; nous les mettons véritablement à l'honneur, en comprenant leurs besoins et leurs aspirations afin de concevoir des campagnes marketing qui trouvent véritablement un écho auprès d'eux.

Les données sont au cœur de notre activité : elles constituent le moteur qui guide chacune de nos décisions, de la stratégie de campagne à la mise en œuvre créative. L'efficacité de nos campagnes ne se limite pas à une simple évaluation ; il s'agit d'un processus continu qui nous permet d'adopter des tactiques agiles et de nous adapter en permanence à un environnement en constante évolution.
La collaboration est notre mot d'ordre : nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec les autres services de Deliverect pour développer et mettre en œuvre des initiatives en parfaite adéquation avec nos objectifs commerciaux globaux.

Mais notre objectif ne se limite pas à atteindre nos objectifs : nous voulons les dépasser !
Notre engagement en faveur d'une croissance et d'une innovation continues fait de Deliverect un leader du secteur en matière de stratégies marketing.
Rejoignez-nous au sein d'une équipe qui ne se contente pas de faire du marketing : nous redéfinissons et sublimons l'expérience dans son ensemble, pour que chaque interaction avec Deliverect soit un moment inoubliable.

Votre impact et votre expérience d’apprentissage :

En tant que stagiaire en marketing au sein de l’équipe marketing régionale de Deliverect, vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans le soutien des initiatives marketing clés dans toute la région EMEA.
Ce stage vous permettra d’acquérir une expérience pratique dans la gestion d’événements, la création de contenu et la mise en œuvre de campagnes, vous offrant ainsi un aperçu précieux du fonctionnement d’une entreprise SaaS B2B dynamique. Vous développerez des compétences fondamentales en marketing tout en contribuant au renforcement de la présence de la marque Deliverect.
Si ce stage est mené à bien, il pourra déboucher sur un poste à temps plein, en fonction de vos performances et de l’adéquation avec les besoins de l’entreprise.


Une journée type
  • Soutien aux événements :
    Assister l’équipe marketing régionale dans l’organisation d’événements internes et externes dans différentes régions, en veillant à leur bon déroulement et à offrir une expérience de grande qualité aux participants.

  • Mise en œuvre des campagnes :
    Contribuer à la mise en œuvre de campagnes marketing tant mondiales que locales, afin de renforcer la notoriété de la marque et de développer des opportunités commerciales sur les marchés cibles.

  • Création et localisation de contenu :

title: Maintenance Technician
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ircagroup
description_html:
Société
Le Groupe IRCA est l’un des principaux fournisseurs internationaux d’ingrédients semi-finis pour les marchés de la boulangerie, de la pâtisserie et de la glace, s’adressant aussi bien aux producteurs indépendants qu’aux grands industriels de l’agroalimentaire (CPG). Ses produits incluent notamment le chocolat, les décorations en chocolat, les crèmes, les mixes pour la boulangerie, les ingrédients pour la glace et d’autres ingrédients de pâtisserie.
En 2023, l’entreprise – dont le siège est en Italie – a acquis RAVIFRUIT, une marque premium de purées de fruits située à Anneyron, en France.
RAVIFRUIT est une marque mondiale qui produit des purées et préparations de fruits de haute qualité pour les circuits Gourmet et PME, distribuant dans plus de 65 pays.

Objectif du poste
Nous recherchons un Technicien de Maintenance H/F rattaché au Responsable Maintenance.

Activités et responsabilités principales:

- Assurer le bon fonctionnement des équipements de production et des utilités, dans le respect des règles d’hygiène, de sécurité et de qualité.
- Diagnostiquer les pannes et dysfonctionnements, définir les actions correctives, réaliser les interventions et en vérifier l’efficacité.
- Réaliser la maintenance préventive et les opérations techniques complexes, tout en mettant à jour la documentation et la GMAO (MVPOne).
- Être un référent technique au sein de l’équipe maintenance et proposer des améliorations sur les installations.
- Collaborer étroitement avec la production, notamment lors des changements de format, réglages et interventions nécessitant un arrêt de ligne.
- Effectuer les rondes quotidiennes des utilités (vapeur, froid, air comprimé…) et contribuer à la gestion du stock de pièces détachées.
- Participer activement aux projets de l’usine et appliquer les procédures qualité, sécurité et environnement.

Formation: Bac+2 Technicien de Maintenance

Compétences professionnelles
- Connaissance de MVPOne
- Compétences en électricité et mécanique

Expérience: Une expérience en environnement industriel (alternance acceptée)

Langue: Français
Compétences informatiques: Maîtrise d’Outlook
Compétences comportementales: Rigueur, Organisation

title: Customer Success Manager (Gestionnaire de compte)

description_html:
Une nouvelle vision pour la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, du live et des loisirs
 
Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et l'une des entreprises technologiques à la croissance la plus rapide au monde. Nous avons révolutionné la billetterie de sites et producteurs comme les Grammy Awards, les Golden Globes, la Fondation Cartier, la Fondation Louis Vuitton ou Culturespaces transformant les process de billetterie et les données collectées lors des parcours de vente en avantage stratégique. Bénéficiant d’investissements à hauteur de 65 millions de dollars vivenu permet aux organisateurs d'événements de mettre en avant leur identité, de transformer l’expérience client, et d'intégrer la billetterie de manière transparente dans leur écosystème numérique.
 
vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles.
 
Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation des métiers de la billetterie et du marketing.

En tant que Customer Success Manager, vos responsabilités comprendront :
  • Maîtrise technique et alignement stratégique : gérer proactivement votre portefeuille clients en devenant l’expert produit de référence. Développer des plans d’actions qui traduisent les objectifs de vos clients en configurations techniques de la plateforme vivenu.
  • Implémentation et architecture applicative : piloter l’intégration technique de vos partenaires. Analyser les workflows existants pour concevoir des solutions sur mesure au sein de l’écosystème vivenu, garantissant un déploiement efficace et scalable.
  • Expertise produit et innovation : agir en tant que consultant technologique pour renforcer les partenariats avec vos clients lors d’ateliers techniques. Mobiliser vos clients autour d’initiatives comme le Lab vivenu pour coconcevoir et tester de nouvelles briques technologiques.
  • Optimisation opérationnelle : conseiller vos clients sur l’utilisation avancée des fonctionnalités de vivenu pour maximiser l’expérience utilisateur et stimuler les revenus grâce à l’utilisation des données et automatiser les processus opérationnels complexes.
  • Analyse de données et santé technique : monitorer les indicateurs de performance (KPIs) et les logs d’utilisation pour identifier les blocages techniques ou les sous-utilisations, et déployer des correctifs concrets.
  • Croissance et expansion technologique : identifier les opportunités d’extension de contrats en démontrant la valeur ajoutée de nouveaux modules fonctionnels ou d’intégrations API supplémentaires.
  •  Interface produit / ingénierie : assurer l’interface entre vos clients et les équipes produit et techniques. Traduire les retours clients en spécifications techniques détaillées pour influencer directement la feuille de route logicielle de vivenu.
  • Expertise et transfert de compétences : assurer une veille constante sur les évolutions techniques de la plateforme. Concevoir et dispenser des formations techniques de haut niveau pour garantir l’adoption des fonctionnalités les plus pointues pour répondre et dépasser les objectifs de vos clients.

    • Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir dans ce rôle :
  • Gestion des relations avec vos interlocuteurs : capacité avérée à établir et à maintenir des relations solides avec un large éventail d’interlocuteurs – y compris les responsables de la billetterie, les équipes numériques et informatiques et la direction.
  • Gestion de portefeuille et priorisation : expérience dans la gestion d'un portefeuille de clients, avec la capacité de gérer efficacement le temps et les ressources en fonction des besoins, des objectifs et des indicateurs de performance de vos clients.
  • Planification stratégique : compétences dans la création de plans stratégiques fondés sur la connaissance client, les informations du CRM, les données d'utilisation en temps réel et les tendances pertinentes du marché.
  • Communication efficace sous différents formats : aisance dans l'animation d'ateliers, la présentation produits et la conduite de revues d'affaires au niveau exécutif – avec un message adapté à chaque public.
  • Engagement sur le produit : une approche technique rigoureuse et la volonté de vous engager directement dans la configuration de la plateforme pour répondre au mieux aux enjeux et objectifs de vos clients.
  • Aisance technique : une capacité à expliquer clairement les concepts techniques – tels que les fonctionnalités liées à la sécurité, les API et les intégrations monétiques – d'une manière accessible à vos interlocuteurs qu’ils aient des profils techniques ou non.
  • Résolution proactive de problèmes : un état d'esprit orienté vers la recherche de solutions, en particulier lors de l’analyse de points complexes et de défis techniques.
  • Gestion de projet : compréhension approfondie de la méthodologie de suivi de projets et d’engagement, y compris la réation de valeur et les stratégies d’engagement à long terme.
  • Expérience professionnelle : 3+ années d'expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : customer success ou chef de projet pour un service logiciel — en général et dans le secteur de la billetterie en particulier.
  • Français & Anglais courants (niveau C1/C2) requis afin d’assurer une communication fluide et professionnelle avec nos clients et partenaires francophones.
    • Pourquoi rejoindre vivenu ?
     
    Pour être au cœur de l’exploitation de clients de renommée mondiale, en redéfinissant l’expérience utilisateur, grâce à une technologie de rupture.
     
    Une croissance durable
    Nous nous développons durablement en mettant l’accent sur la rentabilité et sommes soutenus par des fonds d’investissement de premier plan. Cela signifie un investissement continu dans nos employés, nos produits et notre vision à long terme.
     
    Une équipe engagée et mue par l’excellence
    Collaborez avec plus de 130 professionnels dévoués, comprenant des leaders venant de Google, Slack et Salesforce. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir des technologies au service de la culture, des événements et des loisirs.
     
    Une emprise globale
    Nous sommes une équipe riche de sa diversité, axée sur le mérite — et répartie dans six bureaux dans le monde. Le talent et l'impact sont ce qui compte avant tout chez vivenu.
     
    Une croissance rapide
    Sifted classe vivenu parmi les scale-ups à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous sommes nourris par la volonté d’apprendre au quotidien et de nous améliorer continuement.
     
    Développer notre position de leaders et contribuer directement à la transformation de notre industrie
    Travaillez aux côtés de visionnaires — des fondateurs de Forbes 30 Under 30, aux lauréats du prix Executive of the Year. Chez vivenu, vous contribuerez à établir les nouvelles normes de l'industrie de la billetterie.
     
    Consultez la mission et les valeurs d'entreprise de vivenu ici.
     
    Chez vivenu, nous croyons que nos employés sont la clé de notre succès – et que l’esprit audacieux et la diversité de nos collaborateurs sont une richesse. Nous nous engageons à créer un cadre de travail qui offre à chaque collaborateur la possibilité de contribuer au succès de tous et de s'épanouir.

title: Technical Advisor – Airframe & Engine
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Jetsupport
description_html:
About JSSI
Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Chicago, Jet Support Services, Inc. (JSSI) is the largest independent provider of hourly cost maintenance programs for business aviation. JSSI delivers comprehensive coverage for engines, airframes, and auxiliary power units (APUs) across more than 300 different aircraft makes and models, helping owners and operators stabilize maintenance budgets, maximize aircraft availability, and protect asset value throughout the lifecycle of ownership.   JSSI has built a portfolio of complementary business lines designed to simplify the economic and technical complexity of business aviation; these include Maintenance teams, Traxxall maintenance tracking software, Parts & Engines, Conklin aircraft cost and performance data, and Aviation Capital asset-based financing solutions. Together, these offerings support owners, operators, and maintenance providers with integrated tools spanning ownership and maintenance planning, execution, and financial management.   With more than 6,500 aircraft supported through programs and software platforms, JSSI leverages its unique independence, unmatched scale, and data-driven insight to deliver customized solutions and support models aligned to the interests of each client — regardless of aircraft platform. JSSI is backed by leading institutional investors GTCR, Genstar Capital, and Blackstone. Learn more at jetsupport.com. 

Position Summary

The Technical Advisor serves as the primary point of contact between the Client and the maintenance organization for both airframe and engine matters, acting as a trusted technical representative throughout the lifecycle of aircraft maintenance events. This role manages and coordinates client needs across routine maintenance, minor unscheduled findings, major scheduled inspections, and Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations — for airframes, engines, and related systems — utilizing Product Line Specialists (PLS) as needed to support events requiring specialized assistance.

As the customer's key technical liaison, the Technical Advisor acts as an advocate for the Client and provides expert guidance to support informed decision-making, balancing airworthiness, operational impact, cost control, and schedule adherence.


Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with customers to evaluate and recommend the most appropriate inspection and maintenance alternatives for airframe and engine events.
  • Set up and support customers in coordinating all aspects of maintenance events — including preliminary scheduled inspections, minor unscheduled findings, and major unscheduled or major scheduled events — with assigned repair facilities and service providers.
  • Provide on-site customer representation, particularly during major scheduled inspections.
  • Support customers during Aircraft on Ground (AOG) events, ensuring timely communication and resolution.
  • Create and manage Service Calls to track technical data, event progress, and support financial forecasting.
  • Develop and maintain strong client relationships through regular and proactive communication.
  • Build and sustain working relationships with regional service facilities, mobile repair teams, and other service providers.
  • Research aircraft logbooks and/or perform visual inspections for new enrollments or existing contract reviews.
  • Review and process invoices in AMS, meeting turn-time goals established by Technical Services Management and company policy.
  • Perform event triage by assessing maintenance findings and ensuring each situation is handled appropriately and efficiently, serving as primary liaison between maintenance facilities, parts sourcing vendors, and the customer — handling the event directly or turning it over to a Product Line Specialist as needed.
  • Conduct asset inspections when enrolling new aircraft into service programs.
  • Maintain a thorough working knowledge of applicable contracts, policies, and procedures.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by Technical Services Management.

    • Desired Credentials:
  • Unrestricted work and residency authorization in the United States required.
  • Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) ratings, or equivalent, required.
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in an Aviation field preferred.
  • 10 years' experience with corporate turbine-powered business aircraft (not commercial) preferred, with particular expertise working with Gulfstream and Bombardier airframes and their associated engine platforms.
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to read and write articulately and analytically.
  • Clear understanding of relevant technical skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work well under pressure.
  • Well organized.
  • Have or be able to obtain a passport and perform international travel.
    • At JSSI, we are committed to rewarding our team members with competitive and comprehensive compensation packages that reflect their contributions and talent.
     
    For this role, the annual base pay generally ranges from $90,000 to $105,000, with the final offer determined by variable factors including but not limited to market location, job-specific knowledge, skills, education, and experience. In addition, your total rewards package may include an annual discretionary bonus plan, incentive or sales bonus plan, or other form of additional compensation, based on your role.
     
    Additionally, for full-time employees based in the USA, Canada, or the Philippines, we are proud to offer a robust suite of benefits. This ranges from insurance offerings such as medical, dental, vision, retirement savings programs, among others, starting day one of employment. For a full overview of our offerings, visit the JSSI Benefits Page on our company website.

    JSSI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristic protected by law.

    JSSI does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team.

description_html:
Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d’utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs professionnels dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L’entreprise propose des solutions complètes de bout en bout pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur taille. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs couvrant la protection anti-intrusion, la vidéosurveillance, la sécurité incendie et la protection des personnes, ainsi que le confort et l’automatisation. Ajax Systems emploie aujourd’hui plus de 5 000 collaborateurs.
 
Nous développons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts sur le terrain sont les mieux placés pour comprendre les spécificités de chaque marché. L’entreprise dispose de représentants commerciaux dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, Espagne, Allemagne, France, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, Australie, Afrique du Sud, ainsi que dans de nombreuses autres régions. L’équipe Global Business Development est composée de profils partageant les ambitions élevées et la vision de croissance d’Ajax Systems.
 
La combinaison du meilleur logiciel et d’un matériel puissant a durablement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Récompensée lors des plus grands salons spécialisés tels que IFSEC, Expoprotection et Intersec, et lauréate de prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence comme PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax Systems est aujourd’hui l’un des fabricants de systèmes de sécurité les plus primés en Europe.
La production d’Ajax Systems repose sur quatre sites industriels : deux en Ukraine, un en Turquie et un au Vietnam. Par ailleurs, la certification de l’entreprise selon la norme ISO 14001 garantit un impact environnemental minimal de ses activités de production. La sélection des composants utilisés dans la fabrication des dispositifs Ajax repose sur des déclarations des fournisseurs confirmant leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.
 
L’entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. C’est pourquoi la résilience est au cœur de l’ADN de la marque. Lutter contre le mal en créant les meilleures solutions de sécurité et d’automatisation constitue la mission constante et inébranlable d’Ajax Systems.

title: IT Support Specialist (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at eHealth-Connect GmbH
description_html:
Du hast Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen, behältst auch bei mehreren offenen Themen den Überblick und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären?

Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen.

Bei eHealth-Connect entwickeln wir digitale Lösungen für die vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Produkte werden von unterschiedlichen Akteuren im Gesundheitswesen genutzt – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen, wenn Fragen entstehen, Prozesse nicht wie erwartet laufen oder technische Unterstützung benötigt wird.

Dabei geht es bei uns nicht um klassischen Callcenter-Support, sondern darum, Probleme wirklich zu verstehen, strukturiert einzugrenzen und gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Teams Lösungen zu finden.

Warum brauchen wir diese Rolle?

Mit unseren Produkten, Kunden und Anwendungsfällen wächst auch die Zahl der Themen, die im täglichen Betrieb schnell und zuverlässig gelöst werden müssen. Deshalb möchten wir unseren Support weiter professionalisieren und suchen jemanden, der Supportfälle strukturiert übernimmt, technische Zusammenhänge analysiert und dafür sorgt, dass unsere Kund:innen schnell die richtige Unterstützung bekommen. Gleichzeitig bist du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zu unseren technischen und fachlichen Teams: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder, bereitest komplexere Fälle sauber auf und hilfst damit auch uns, unsere Produkte und Prozesse kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

Warum ist die Rolle spannend?

Du bearbeitest bei uns nicht einfach Tickets nach Schema F.

Unsere Lösungen bewegen sich in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld und verbinden Software, unterschiedliche Systeme, Schnittstellen und Prozesse im Gesundheitswesen miteinander. Das bedeutet: Hinter einer Supportanfrage steckt manchmal eine einfache Bedienfrage – manchmal aber auch ein technisches Puzzle. Du lernst unsere Produkte und Systeme sehr genau kennen, arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Deployment und Fachbereichen zusammen und entwickelst mit der Zeit ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo ein Problem entsteht und wie wir es am besten lösen können.

Aufgaben

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Annahme, Erfassung und Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen unserer Kund:innen
  • Unterstützung der Anwender:innen bei Fragen zur Bedienung und zu den Prozessen unserer Produkte
  • Analyse und erste Eingrenzung technischer und fachlicher Fehler
  • Prüfung von Fehlermeldungen, Prozessstatus, Logs und vorhandenen Systeminformationen
  • Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Supportfällen sowie Überwachung vereinbarter Service Levels
  • Lösung bekannter Störungen anhand vorhandener Dokumentationen und Workarounds
  • Qualifizierte Eskalation komplexerer Fälle an 2nd Level, Entwicklung oder zuständige Fachbereiche
  • Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation von Lösungen und wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern in unserer Wissensdatenbank

Qualifikation

Was hilft dir, in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein?

Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass du gerne Probleme löst, strukturiert arbeitest und Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen hast.

  • Erfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder technischen Kundensupport ist von Vorteil
  • Gutes technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen sowie im Umgang mit Fehlermeldungen und Logs
  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie eine klare, freundliche und verbindliche Kommunikation
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Kenntnisse im IT-Service-Management, zum Beispiel nach ITIL v4, sind wünschenswert
  • Grundkenntnisse in Webanwendungen, APIs und JSON sind von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

Uns ist wichtiger, wie du an Probleme herangehst, wie du kommunizierst und ob du Lust hast, dich in unsere Produkte und Technologien einzuarbeiten, als dass du bereits jedes Kästchen erfüllst. Auch der sinnvolle Einsatz von KI im Arbeitsalltag wird bei uns ausdrücklich gefördert und ist bereits Teil unserer Arbeitsweise.

Über eHealth-Connect

Wir entwickeln Software und digitale Lösungen für eine moderne, vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Technologien verbinden unterschiedliche Akteure und Systeme im Gesundheitswesen und tragen dazu bei, digitale Versorgung einfacher, sicherer und besser nutzbar zu machen.

Dabei arbeiten wir an der Schnittstelle zwischen moderner Softwareentwicklung, Telematikinfrastruktur und neuen digitalen Versorgungskonzepten.

Wir arbeiten hybrid und haben ein modernes Büro in Berlin-Mitte, das wir als Ort für Zusammenarbeit, Austausch und gemeinsame Teamtage nutzen.

Klingt nach etwas, das zu dir passen könnte?

Dann melde dich bei uns. Ob mit Lebenslauf oder einfach ein paar Sätzen darüber, wer du bist, was du bisher gemacht hast und warum dich die Rolle interessiert – wir möchten vor allem dich kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

title: FP&A Analyst
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Kraken
description_html:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in

We are building out a world-class Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to support our rapid global growth. We’re looking for a high-calibre FP&A Analyst with a background in investment banking, private equity, or top-tier strategy or finance roles.

This is a rare chance to move from advisory into operating, where you’ll help shape the trajectory of one of the most ambitious multinational SaaS platforms in the market. You’ll be in the engine room of strategic decision-making, with daily exposure to senior leadership and a clear path to accelerated career growth while at the same time making a big green dent in the world.

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Financial Modelling:  Build simple and pragmatic analysis to answer questions and support recommendations, before the questions arise.  Build and maintain complex models for scenario planning, evaluating potential investments, and assessing risks.

  • Budgeting, Performance Analysis & Forecasting: Help to run the annual budgeting process.  On a monthly and quarterly basis, develop and continuously refine reporting &  KPIs to improve transparency, accountability, and decision-making.  

  • Data guru: Become a master of data sources, respond to ad hoc questions quickly, accurately, and proactively. Develop dashboards into scalable, self service tools.

  • Operational problem solving: Proactively diagnose operational bottlenecks. Deploy tactical, data-driven solutions to remove friction in day-to-day execution.

  • Executive Materials: Prepare high-quality analysis and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Business Partnering: Collaborate with commercial, product, and operations leaders to align financial outcomes with strategic initiatives.

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Technical & advanced analytics: Advanced Google Sheets or Excel proficiency. SQL. Experience with BI tools like Power BI, Tableau, or specialised FP&A software (e.g., Pigment, Anaplan) is beneficial. 

  • Proven ability to work in ambiguity: You can, with some support, frame a problem, find the right data,  test hypotheses and move forward without waiting for perfect inputs. You can draw out the insights from complex or incomplete data.

  • Business acumen:  You can join the dots between business imperatives, stakeholders’ priorities, and external factors.

  • Communication: You can challenge assumptions constructively and confidently with senior stakeholders.  You can create board-ready and management level materials. 

  • Experience: More than 2 years in investment banking, private equity, strategy consulting, or top-tier corporate finance/FP&A.  

  • Proactive self-starter: The ability to work independently in a fast-moving, scaling environment.

  • Low Ego: You are equally comfortable developing the 3-year plan for the Board as you are digging into broken cell references in a Google sheet.  You are happy to ask for help when you need it, and you jump in to help other people.

  • A "maker": You don’t do things "because that's how they’re done." You ask questions and figure out if there’s another way to do things.

  • You are commercially curious and outcome-focused.

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5, and in Germany we rate 4.7 on Kununu as a Top Company. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

 

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at ----- We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms

Please note that, in line with our current recruitment policy, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must have the right to work in the country that they're applying to, at the time of application.*

description_html:
About Ultralytics:

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the linkcreators of the world's leading Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs. This is an opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-performance team that's redefining the future of vision AI — where ambition meets impact, and ideas become reality.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll turn complex computer vision problems into production systems built on YOLO. You'll lead technical discovery, design architectures, build benchmarks and proof-of-concepts, and guide customers from their first conversation to deployed models.

You'll work across Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering while partnering directly with customers in manufacturing, retail, security, robotics, and beyond. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys writing Python, training and optimizing models, deploying across cloud and edge, and owning outcomes throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you thrive on ambiguous problems, direct customer contact, and turning technical possibilities into measurable results, you'll fit right in.

🚀 What you'll do
Technical discovery and solution design

  • Own technical discovery, translate customer needs into architectures, and define measurable success criteria.

  • Evaluate customer data, recommend models, and design training, inference, and deployment strategies.

  • Lead technical qualification and solution design alongside Account Executives and Customer Success Managers.


Prototyping and deployment

  • Build Python prototypes with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and Docker.

  • Create benchmarks, integrations, and production-ready training and deployment workflows.

  • Deploy solutions across Linux, macOS, Windows, cloud, and edge environments.

  • Diagnose performance, data quality, inference, and hardware acceleration challenges.

  • Use the Ultralytics documentation and YOLO guides to deliver reliable customer outcomes.


Customer engagement and enablement

  • Deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and proof-of-concepts that move opportunities forward.

  • Explain machine learning clearly to engineers, operators, executives, and other non-technical audiences.

  • Build trusted relationships and manage technical stakeholders from evaluation through production.


Ecosystem contribution

  • Turn customer solutions into reusable examples, deployment guides, integrations, and documentation.

  • Share feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the YOLO ecosystem.

  • Engage developers through the Ultralytics community and GitHub organization.


📈 What success looks like

  • 3 months: Ramped on the YOLO stack and customers, co-running discovery, and delivering your first demos and project kickoffs.

  • 6 months: Owning technical discovery and POCs end to end, unblocking live deals or at-risk accounts, and earning trust from the AEs and CSMs you support.

  • 9 months: Converting technical evaluations into wins or saves, shipping reusable assets, and providing actionable feedback to the wider organization.

  • 12 months: Becoming the technical partner AEs and CSMs want on their biggest accounts, with POCs that convert and referenceable customer deployments.


🧠 Skills and experience
Core requirements

  • Strong Python and practical experience with YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and computer vision.

  • Experience training, optimizing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Comfortable with Docker, Git, REST APIs, Linux, cloud platforms, and edge workflows.

  • Experience deploying across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.

  • Proven ability to deliver technical demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and POCs.

  • Strong communication skills with both technical and executive audiences.

  • Independent ownership, urgency, resilience, and results in a high-performance startup environment.

  • Passion for AI, open source, and helping customers achieve real outcomes.


Nice to have

  • Kubernetes, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, Jetson, or other edge accelerators.

  • Experience with MLOps, model monitoring, CI/CD, or observability.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP, serverless systems, or managed inference platforms.

  • Experience integrating OpenAI or Anthropic APIs into customer tools.

  • Open-source contributions or experience supporting developer communities.

  • Knowledge of Ultralytics YOLO workflows and production computer vision solutions.


🌟 Why this role

  • Real impact: Your solutions will power vision AI in production across systems used by millions of devices.

  • Demand you don't have to manufacture: YOLO is the world's most popular computer vision model, and customers already come to us looking to do more with it.

  • Build at the source: Work directly on top of the YOLO ecosystem with clear lines to Product and Engineering.

  • A team that ships: Join a fast-moving, high-standard team that values results over routine.

  • Customer ownership: Stay involved beyond the demo and see your technical work reach production.


🚫 What this isn't
This isn't a slideware Solutions Engineer role. You won't hand off after the demo or hide behind a deck — you'll build the solution, get it deployed, and own the technical outcome throughout the client lifecycle.

🌟 Cultural fit
At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.

  • Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

  • Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure.

  • See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.

💰 Compensation and benefits
We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title.

  • Competitive compensation: Competitive compensation packages

  • On-site collaboration: Work with passionate builders in one of our global hubs (London).

  • Flexible working hours: We value results over routines.

  • Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.

  • Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.

  • Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.

  • Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.

  • High impact: Your work will shape the future of vision AI.


👉 Check out Ultralytics careers and our office locations to learn more about our culture, values, and teams.

description_html:
What is the job?

Ready to be part of a fast-growing business where no two days look the same? We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised and solutions-focused People Operations Coordinator to support our growing teams and help deliver a brilliant employee experience across the business.

This is a hands-on, hybrid role sitting at the heart of our People function. You’ll support the day-to-day delivery of People Operations, working closely with managers and teams across the business. From onboarding and systems administration to employee lifecycle processes, you’ll play an important role in keeping things running smoothly and helping us scale effectively.

You’ll need to be comfortable working at pace, managing changing priorities and using your judgement to find practical solutions. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just identify a problem, but takes ownership of working through it and getting it resolved.

Experience within healthcare or another regulated environment would be beneficial, but it is not essential. What matters most is your ability to stay organised, think on your feet and deliver accurate, high-quality work in a fast-moving business.

What will you be doing?

  • Support the day-to-day running of the People function across the full employee lifecycle

  • Coordinate onboarding activities for new starters, ensuring a smooth and organised experience from offer through to induction

  • Ensure onboarding documentation, right to work checks, training records and compliance processes are completed accurately and within the required timelines

  • Maintain accurate employee records across our HR systems and internal trackers

  • Support with People administration, including contract generation, employee changes, probation documentation and offboarding processes

  • Act as a first point of contact for employee queries, providing timely, professional and solutions-focused support

  • Coordinate People processes, including probation reviews, training records, employee communications and engagement initiatives

  • Support managers and the wider People team with administrative and operational requirements

  • Maintain People policies, process documents and internal guidance materials

  • Support reporting, data tracking and audits to ensure accurate records and strong compliance standards

  • Work collaboratively with teams across the business to deliver a positive and efficient employee experience

  • Take ownership of operational issues, investigating the cause and identifying practical solutions

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce unnecessary administration and increase operational efficiency as the business grows

What do you need?

  • Previous experience within a People Operations, HR administration or coordination role

  • Strong practical problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess an issue, use your judgement and identify workable solutions

  • A proactive, solutions-focused mindset and the confidence to take ownership of tasks through to completion

  • The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment where priorities can change quickly

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities

  • Strong administrative and coordination skills with excellent follow-through

  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills

  • A calm, approachable and responsive manner when supporting employees and managers

  • The confidence to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance or escalate an issue

  • The ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately

  • Confidence using HR systems and maintaining accurate employee data

  • Experience using HiBob would be advantageous, but is not essential

  • Experience within healthcare or another regulated, high-growth environment would be beneficial, but is not essential

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation: £30K – £37.5K

title: Accuracy Checking Pharmacy Technician (Part-time)

description_html:
Tired of retail pharmacy?

Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes.

No retail counter. No walk-in patients. No OTC. Focus entirely on delivering safe, high-quality pharmacy care.

Modern pharmacy. State of the art renovated premises with onsite Free parking

That's what we're building at Montu.

What is the job?

You will be a central, trusted part of our pharmacy operation at our Winnersh site — the person the team relies on to make sure every medicine that leaves our pharmacy is right. That means accuracy checking dispensed medicines, keeping standards high, and actively contributing to a culture where getting it right the first time is non-negotiable. You will not be managed through every task. You will be trusted to lead, to spot problems before they become incidents, and to raise the bar for everyone around you.

What will you be doing?

  • Carrying out accuracy checks on dispensed medicines, ensuring full compliance with legal, operational and safety standards

  • Taking ownership of the end-to-end dispensing process — not just your part of it

  • Maintaining clear, accurate prescription records and escalating discrepancies without hesitation

  • Actively mentoring junior colleagues and helping to build a team culture rooted in accountability, safety and quality

  • Staying sharp on professional development, best practice and regulatory changes — because you want to, not because you have to

  • Working with pace and purpose alongside the wider pharmacy team to ensure every patient gets exactly what they need, when they need it

What do you need?

  • Level 3 NVQ in Pharmacy Services (ACT) or equivalent ACT qualification

  • Current registration as a Pharmacy Technician with the GPhC — no exceptions

  • Solid, proven experience in a pharmacy setting with a strong track record in accuracy checking

  • Deep working knowledge of pharmacy regulations, policies and SOPs

  • The kind of attention to detail that you simply cannot switch off

  • Someone who communicates directly, takes accountability for their actions, and does not wait to be told what to do

  • A genuine, proven commitment to patient outcomes — not just patient care on paper, but real passion for what happens to the person at the end of the process

What we offer:

  • Part-time hours: We offer 16 and 24 hours per week contract (8 hours per day)

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

title: Senior AI Product Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Elliptic
description_html:
Do you want to build the AI systems that compliance teams rely on to investigate real financial crime? Are you excited about taking agentic workflows from prototype to production at scale? Do you want your work to directly help catch bad actors moving money across blockchains?

Elliptic is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI team. It is the team behind Elliptic's copilot, the AI product that helps compliance investigators trace fund flows, surface patterns, and respond to risk in real time. This role sits at the centre of that work, designing the agentic systems, LLM integrations, and backend services that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers.

You'll join a focused team that cares about the quality of what it builds and gives you the space to do your best work. There's real ownership here, breadth across AI and backend systems, and the freedom to turn good ideas into shipped products. The problems are technically challenging, and the work is visible.

The impact you will have:

As a Senior AI Engineer on the AI team, you'll own significant parts of the Agentic stack that power Elliptic's copilot. You'll lead the design of agentic workflows, drive technical decisions on how we build and operate LLM-based features, and help raise the engineering standard across the team. You'll partner with product, web engineers, and your engineering lead to take complex problems from ambiguity to shipped product, and you'll mentor more junior engineers as the team grows.

What you will do:

  • Design and build agentic workflows and AI-powered features that power Elliptic's copilot, using LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.

  • Lead the design of agents, tool integrations, and retrieval pipelines that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers for investigators.

  • Build and own evaluation frameworks that measure and improve the quality, reliability, and latency of LLM outputs.

  • Design and build the backend services, APIs, and event-driven systems that support these features, using TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Drive technical design reviews and architecture decisions for AI workstreams.

  • Mentor and coach more junior engineers through pair programming, code review, and design feedback.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the team by promoting good practices in testing, observability, and AI system reliability.

  • Influence cross-team decisions on how AI capabilities integrate with the rest of the Elliptic platform.

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • Owned and shipped at least one significant AI capability end-to-end, from ambiguous problem statement through to production.

  • Driven the technical direction of an AI workstream, including architecture, evaluation, and rollout.

  • Established or improved at least one team practice for building AI systems (evals, observability patterns, prompt management, rollout safety).

  • Mentored junior engineers on AI engineering practices and contributed to their growth.

  • Built strong working relationships across product, web engineering, data engineering, and DevOps.

  • Started to influence adjacent teams on how Elliptic builds with AI.

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Care about building AI systems that work reliably in production, not just demos.

  • Have strong instincts for trade-offs specific to LLM systems: cost vs latency vs quality, deterministic vs probabilistic behaviour, when to use an agent vs a workflow.

  • Can take ambiguous AI problems and break them into shippable pieces with clear evaluation criteria.

  • Communicate clearly with non-engineers (product, stakeholders, leadership) about AI capabilities and limitations.

  • Have coached or mentored other engineers and enjoy raising the bar through reviews, pairing, and feedback.

  • Are genuinely curious about the domain and find blockchain investigations and financial crime prevention interesting.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • 5-8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years of meaningful production work building LLM-powered features.

  • Direct experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, planning, memory, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

  • Practical understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, and managing the trade-offs of working with LLMs.

  • Experience building and running evaluations for LLM outputs (eval sets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing).

  • Strong backend skills in TypeScript / Node.js, with solid API design.

  • Cloud experience (AWS: Lambda, ECS, S3, or similar).

  • Database proficiency across SQL (Postgres) and some NoSQL exposure.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach other engineers.

  • Uses AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) critically and effectively as part of their day-to-day workflow.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, or similar).

  • Experience designing multi-agent systems and agent orchestration patterns.

  • Familiarity with LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or similar).

  • Experience working with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-weight models) or with fine-tuning.

  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Experience with observability platforms like Datadog.

  • Distributed or event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS).

  • Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain, or compliance.

Job Benefits

> How we work:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

> Learning & Development:

  • $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

> Vacation/ Leave:

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

  • Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

  • Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it's important for us to mention it here. We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us. We know incredible people don't all think in the same way. We want to be challenged every day. We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles. We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.
