title: Director of Product Marketing
description_html:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Director, Product Marketing

We're looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own how Help Scout tells its story in a crowded, fast-growing market – shaping the positioning, narrative, and go-to-market strategy that define how customers, prospects, and the industry understand our platform.

It's an exciting time to be here. With a new vision and an AI-driven vision, we’ll be shipping more products faster to ensure we can quickly meet the changing needs of the market. You'll set the strategy for how we position that pace of innovation, build the frameworks that help the whole company talk about it credibly, and make sure our AI-driven product investments land as real value in the market not just feature noise. You'll report to the VP of Marketing, leading our product marketing function, and will manage our Lead Product Marketing Manager.

Please note: This role is only open to US-based applicants.

About the role

  • Own product marketing strategy. Set and execute the quarterly and long-term strategy for how Help Scout positions its product and platform, informed by market trends, competitive analytics, and where the company is headed.

  • Build and scale the product marketing function. Manage and partner with our Lead Product Marketing Manager, setting priorities, coaching on craft, and creating room for them to grow into owning larger initiatives. You'll help build the team's roadmap for headcount and capability over the next 12-18 months.

  • Enable the whole company. Ensure sales, support, and teammates across Help Scout have what they need to understand and clearly articulate the value of what we ship. You'll build the frameworks and enable the company to talk about our products in a way that ultimately leads to new revenue and expansion.

  • Shape competitive intelligence at a strategic level. Go beyond synthesizing competitive research by turning it into a point of view on where the market is heading and how Help Scout should move to win, and make sure that point of view shapes product-led growth, direct and indirect sales, and expansion.

  • Own major product launches and seasonal release events end-to-end. Set the strategy and narrative arc for product release events and other major launches, coordinating across Sales, Product, Support, and Marketing to land them with impact.

  • Represent Help Scout's product story externally. Use guest posts, podcasts, social, and other channels to build the company's external visibility and reputation as a category leader, both for the platform and for how we're building it.

About you

  • You have significant experience in product marketing for a B2B SaaS product or AI platform, with a track record of owning strategy, not just executing campaigns.

  • You're an expert in every core discipline of product marketing: positioning, messaging, buyer personas/ICP, sales enablement, and launches, and you can identify which high-value activities matter most for the business right now.

  • You've managed people before, and know how to coach someone on craft, give them room to own real work, and help them grow into more senior responsibility.

  • You have a point of view on positioning AI-powered products credibly, and ideally have direct experience marketing AI features or products.

  • You use AI tools daily to improve your own output and your team's, and you can point to specific examples where AI changed the speed, quality, or scale of what you or your team delivered.

  • You're a storyteller at heart. You write strong narratives that make complex products feel simple, human, and memorable, and you know how to communicate and build relationships across a remote, async environment.

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

title: Customer Success Manager - UKI
description_html:
HubSpot is looking for a Customer Success Manager who is interested in interested in leading with AI to deliver customer value, build long-lasting relationships, and help customers unlock their full HubSpot potential to achieve their goals. Customer Success Managers are the trusted inbound advisors for each of their customers. They have an intimate understanding of how their businesses work and what the businesses need to grow and thrive. In working with your customers, you will find that no two of them are the same. In the morning, you could be working with the Marketing Manager at a carpet manufacturer about how to rank for the keyword “stain resistant carpet” through more effective blogging. In the afternoon, you could be talking to the CMO of a software company about how to convert more of their free trials into customers through marketing automation and the sales platform.

This role is open in our Dublin Office as well as Remote and Flex.

In this Role you’ll get to:

  • Manage 150 – 180 customer relationships. Some of your customers will be new while others may have been using HubSpot for several years.
  • Work with your customers on a regular basis to understand their goals and aligning them with the necessary resources to achieve them.
  • Partner with different teams at HubSpot to 'solve for the customer' including onboarding, up-sell/x-sell, and renewals. Along the way, you will get to know HubSpot’s software incredibly well and help your customers fully adopt the platform.
  • Your day-to-day is a mix of proactive and reactive work, and CSMs have a lot of autonomy in managing their “book of business”. The proactive work includes 4-5 scheduled deep-dive meetings per day with customers, where you review their progress, make strategic and tactical recommendations, and keep them up to date on the latest and greatest features from HubSpot. The reactive work runs the gamut from questions about invoices to “how to” questions about the software
  • Promote the growth of your install base by uncovering, scoping and qualifying opportunities where customers can use more Hubspot products and services to ensure customer retention and growth
  • Understand technical roadblocks and make recommendations on solution implementation and core integrations using Hubspot to overcome them

If you’re stimulated by problem solving - whether it’s a business or technical challenge – this is the role for you.

To excel in this role you will need to have:

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing or account management role,
  • Business savvy with consultative, problem solving, and issue resolution skills
  • Strong knowledge of the media/digital landscape
  • Motivated self-starter who is hungry to learn and can provide strong examples of how they have achieved results while balancing demanding expectations
  • Super organised, quick learner who works well under pressure
  • Strong negotiation skills, comfortable navigating financial conversations, and dealing with cancellations
  • It’s easy for you to build and maintain relationships, manage expectations, and identify issues that require escalation
  • Knowledge of Loop Marketing, AEO, and LLM or the aptitude to learn it quickly and independently are required
  • Support an on-going partner relationship to maximise acquisition, retention, and up-sell rates

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:

€56.900—€78.235 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Explore more:

  • HubSpot Careers
  • Life at HubSpot on Instagram

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

title: Business Development Representative - DACH
description_html:
Standort: Remote in Deutschland oder flexibles Büro in Berlin

Wir bei HubSpot laden alle, unabhängig vom Abschluss, ein, sich unserem Vertriebsteam als Business Development Representative (kurz BDR) anzuschließen. Unser Ziel ist es, eine vielfältige und inklusive Arbeitsumgebung zu schaffen, die Talente verschiedener Generationen schätzt und fördert. Ob du gerade deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen hast oder deine Karriere im SaaS-Vertrieb beschleunigen möchtest, wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Gemäß Modells für die Zukunft der Arbeit bieten wir sowohl Büro- als auch Remote-Arbeitsmöglichkeiten innerhalb Deutschlands an.

Die Aufgabe eines Business Development Representative besteht darin, durch strategische Kundengewinnung geeignete Unternehmen zu identifizieren und mit diesen zu interagieren. Dies geschieht unter Verwendung bereits existierender HubSpot-Leads, deren Interesse durch Anrufe, E-Mails sowie Messaging über soziale Medien erneut geweckt wird.

Im Rahmen deiner Kontaktaufnahme mit potenzieller Kundschaft erfährst du als BDR mehr darüber, mit welchen Herausforderungen sich das jeweilige Unternehmen konfrontiert sieht, und können so entscheiden, ob HubSpot hier als Lösung herangezogen werden kann. Wenn du einen qualifizierten Interessenten oder eine qualifizierte Interessentin identifiziert hast, besteht Ihr Ziel darin, den Wert von HubSpot prägnant und präzise zu kommunizieren und Interesse an einem tiefer gehenden Gespräch mit einem Account Executive zu wecken.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die enge Zusammenarbeit mit 2 bis 3 Account Executives. Du wirst täglich mit den von dir unterstützten Account Executives sowie mit anderen BDRs zusammenarbeiten, um innovative Strategien zur Ermittlung neuer Opportunität zu entwickeln. BDRs, die sich erfolgreich in ihrer Rolle behaupten, werden anschließend zu Account Executives innerhalb unseres Vertriebsteams.

Was fällt in den Verantwortungsbereich eines Business Development Representative?

Folgende Aufgaben und Verantwortungen erwarten dich in dieser Vollzeitsbeschäftigung:

  • Ein hoher Umfang an Outbound-Aktivitäten zur Akquise und Qualifizierung von Leads (neue Kunden)
  • Eng mit Account Executives zusammenarbeiten, um Strategien und Pläne für die Kundengewinnung zu entwickeln und zu implementieren
  • Planen von Online-Produktdemonstrationen für qualifizierte Leads bei gleichzeitigem Sicherstellen, dass deine monatlichen Ziele erreicht werden
  • Verstehen der Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen von Kunden und Kundinnen unter Einsatz bestimmter Verkaufsmethoden wie der BANT-Methodik
  • Durchführen von Marktforschung, um den Kundenstamm von HubSpot zu erweitern

Welche Voraussetzungen gibt es für diese Stelle?

  • Engagement und Begeisterung für die Technologiebranche und den Vertrieb
  • Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Vertrieb oder Kundengewinnung und in einer wachstumsstarken „Scale-up“-Umgebung ist nicht erforderlich, aber von Vorteil
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Scharfer, zielorientierter Fokus und ein überzeugender, stringenter Ansatz bei der Zielumsetzung
  • Die Fähigkeit, mit Einwänden umzugehen und auf diese einzugehen, sowie die Bereitschaft, sich coachen zu lassen
  • Starke Organisationsfähigkeit und sehr gutes Zeitmanagement
  • Leidenschaft dafür, Unternehmen bei ihrem Wachstum zu unterstützen, und Interesse für die Technologiebranche

Was hast du davon?

  • Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das persönliche Arbeitspräferenzen berücksichtigt
  • Tolle Teammitglieder in einem kulturell vielfältigen Arbeitsumfeld sowie Unterstützung durch eine Mentorin oder einen Mentor
  • Interaktives Mitarbeitertraining und ein einmonatiges Onboarding, um dir den Einstieg zu erleichtern
  • Ein klar abgesteckter Karriereweg mit regelmäßigen Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten
  • Erstattung von Studiengebühren in Höhe von maximal 4.250 Euro im Jahr und ein kostenloses Bücherprogramm, um die persönliche Weiterbildung zu fördern
  • Coaching- und Therapiesitzungen über die Modern Health-App zur Förderung des mentalen Wohlbefindens sowie andere Gesundheitsleistungen, z. B. Lebensversicherung, Absicherungen im Falle längerer Krankheit oder Erstattung von Fitnessstudiogebühren in Höhe von bis zu 250 Euro

Please note: This is a role that we hire on an ongoing basis throughout the year. If you choose to apply for this role, your information will be reviewed by our recruiting team and we will reach out to you if your background matches an opening at this time or in the future.

#LI-TP1

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:

€46.000—€62.000 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Explore more:

  • HubSpot Careers
  • Life at HubSpot on Instagram

title: Ads Quality Rater - Dutch (Netherlands)
description_html:
Overzicht

Kom de toekomst van het internet vormgeven met je dagelijkse internetvaardigheden!

Als Ads Quality Rater beoordeel en evalueer je internetadvertenties om ze beter en relevanter te maken voor eindgebruikers zoals jijzelf.

Met andere woorden, je vertelt het systeem hoe goed of hoe slecht een advertentie is op basis van je begrip van de trefwoorden die bij elke advertentie verstrekt worden. Je beoordeelt advertenties zowel in het Engels als in het Nederlands.

Deze functie is ideaal voor mensen die:

· Dagelijks op het internet surfen

· Vaak grote zoekmachines gebruiken

· Advertenties herkennen wanneer ze verschijnen

· Houden van online onderzoek doen over verschillende onderwerpen

Daarnaast moeten alle Ads Quality Raters een geheimhoudingsovereenkomst ondertekenen en slagen voor een door de klant verstrekte test voordat ze worden aangenomen.

Deze cruciale stappen garanderen geheimhouding van de klant en een hoog kwaliteitsniveau.

Projectdetails

Functieomschrijving: Ads Quality Rater

Salaris: per taak (ca. $17 USD per uur)

Locatie: op afstand, Nederland

Uren: bepaal je eigen schema gebaseerd op het volgende: minimale inzet is 10 uur per week. Je kunt ervoor kiezen om tot 20 uur per week te werken (als het project dit toelaat).

Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk

Dienstverband: freelance; betaling elke 2 weken

Projectduur: 12 maanden (met mogelijkheid tot verlenging)

De hoeveelheid van data kan van week tot week variëren. Sommige weken is er meer data om te beoordelen, andere weken minder. Van alle Ads Quality Raters wordt verwacht dat zij minimaal 10 uur per week werken.

Aanwervingsproces en stappen

Welo Data streeft naar een inclusief en rechtvaardig wervingsproces. Alle kandidaten dienen de volgende stappen doorlopen om in aanmerking te komen voor dit project:

• Sollicitatie kandidaat

• Welo Data beoordeling sollicitatie

• Kennis, evaluatie en kwalificatie kandidaat

• Welo Data’s klant beoordeling

• Definitieve goedkeuring

Het wervingsproces kan tot 14 dagen in beslag nemen.

Ervaring en vereisten

  • Vloeiend in Nederlands (geschreven en gesproken)
  • Conversationeel in Engels
  • Betrouwbaar computersysteem en internetverbinding
  • Bekend met het gebruik van online zoekmachines
  • Kan instructies in het Engels ontvangen en begrijpen en kan voldoen aan de projectconventies en -regels die door de klant worden verwacht
  • Bereid om een geheimhoudingsverklaring te tekenen ter bescherming van de klant
  • Voldoet aan de leermodules en een vereiste kwaliteitstest ontworpen door onze klant voordat het werk begint

Compensation

Additional Information

Overige informatie

Preventie van fraude

Projecten zoals deze zijn over de hele wereld grote doelwitten van fraude. Daarom voert Welo Data gedurende het hele proces fraudecontroles uit om ervoor te zorgen dat het programma wordt nageleefd. Alle accounts die frauduleus worden bevonden, worden onmiddellijk van het project verwijderd.

Over Welo Data

Welo Data is een wereldwijd data- en vertaalbedrijf met kantoren over de hele wereld. We hebben achter de schermen gewerkt aan een aantal van de grootste technische projecten ooit, van datalokalisatie en vertaling tot generatieve AI en deep learning. We zijn buitengewoon trots op onze klanten, onze medewerkers en de eindgebruikers van alle projecten waar we aan werken.

Please note that this work is based on project needs. Due to this, weekly hours may vary and flexibility with change is expected. You must legally be able to work on freelance projects in the Netherlands.

title: Account Executive SMB -France
description_html:
Account Executive - France - SMB French market

What will you get to do in this SMB France Account Executive role?

As an Account Executive at HubSpot, you use outbound selling strategies to find new business and help them grow using HubSpot software. You run online demos of the HubSpot software and successfully sell the HubSpot value proposition. Your target clients will largely consist of small and mid-sized businesses. This position is a full closing role.

We are actively hiring for a SMB Account Executive; candidates are eligible to be office, flex or remotely located in France based on individual preference! Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot: How We're Building a Hybrid Company.

What are the responsibilities of an Account Executive?

In this role, you will need to:

  • Quickly identify challenges that our prospective customers face and discover the best marketing solutions for their business
  • Consistently close new business at or above quota level on a monthly cadence
  • Build relationships with highly qualified opportunities at small and mid-sized companies
  • Build relationships with internal stakeholders to grow new business

Ads Quality Rater

Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world's largest ad evaluation programs and want you to join our team!

As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and rate internet ads to improve which ads are presented to end users. In other words, you will provide feedback to the AI ​​program on how good or bad its ad suggestions are based on the user's keywords.

You will review ads in both English and German.

This position is ideal for people who:

- surf the Internet daily

- Use search engines regularly

- know what Internet users are searching for based on a few keywords

- enjoy researching topics online

- looking for a flexible and entertaining part-time job

Project details

Job title: Ads Quality Rater (m/f/d)

Remuneration: Variable depending on the complexity of the task

Location: Remote (Germany only)

Working hours: 5-20 hours per week, flexible scheduling

Start Date: Immediately

Employment relationship: Freelancer/self-employed: self-employed contractor

Project duration: long-term

There is no formal interview for this job! No calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether or not you got the job.

Instead, you will be guided through a self-directed and automated recruitment process.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity verification checks to ensure that everyone who joins the team is genuine, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid misunderstandings, do not use IP obfuscation programs (such as VPNs).

Compensation

- Our projects offer you excellent opportunities to develop your career and learn

- And our community team is there for you 24 hours a day, 6 days a week if you need support

Interested in working together? Then apply here !

  • Sujuva englannin kielen taito

title: Senior Solutions Architect (Data & AI)
description_html:
JOB ID: FEQ427R333

Location: Leeds/Manchester, United Kingdom - remote contract

Industry: Enterprise Retail or CPG (UKI Enterprise)

The Role

As a Sr. Solutions Architect, you are an expert-level technical leader responsible for the organisation's most complex customer engagements. You drive consumption strategy, own executive-level relationships, and serve as the definitive technical authority for your accounts. You have declared your archetype—a recognised technical specialisation that makes you a force multiplier across your team and region. You operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic account planning, and executive influence.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Drive the technical and consumption strategy for the organisation's most complex customer engagements, directly influencing platform adoption and revenue growth.
  • Own senior-level technical relationships — serving as a trusted advisor on enterprise data and AI strategy
  • Lead the most complex architecture engagements: multi-workload platforms, enterprise-wide migrations, real-time systems, and AI/ML at scale
  • Operate as an Expert on the Databricks Platform with a declared archetype — actively mentoring others and driving horizontal impact across your team
  • Develop and execute competitive strategies for your customers, positioning Databricks against incumbent and emerging platforms
  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams (DSAs, SSAs, Partners, Product) to deliver enterprise-grade solutions
  • Coach and develop junior SAs (L3–L5) on technical depth, customer engagement, and use case prioritisation
  • Contribute to Field Engineering thought leadership through customer-facing content, workshops, and community engagement

What We Look For

  • 8+ years in solutions architecture, principal engineering, technical pre-sales leadership, or a senior customer-facing technical role
  • Expert-level coding proficiency — Python, SQL, and ideally Spark/PySpark. You will complete a live coding assessment and a platform build during the interview
  • Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture: distributed systems at scale, streaming/real-time, lakehouse design patterns, data governance frameworks, and cloud-native platforms
  • Expert-level Databricks Platform knowledge (or equivalent depth in competing platforms with demonstrated rapid learning ability)
  • Declared technical specialisation with recognised depth — e.g., real-time architectures, ML/AI platforms, data governance, large-scale migrations, or industry-specific solutions
  • Proven track record of driving consumption growth and platform adoption in large accounts
  • Executive presence — ability to influence Directors, VPs, and C-level stakeholders on long-term data and AI strategy
  • Experience leading competitive displacements and complex enterprise evaluations
  • Strong strategic thinking — connecting technical architecture decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience); advanced degrees are valued

Nice to Have:

  • Databricks certifications
  • Prior experience at Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google, Microsoft, or a top-tier data/AI company
  • Published thought leadership (blogs, conference talks, open source contributions)
  • Industry experience in Retail or Consumer Packaged Goods with executive-level domain credibility

Interview Process: Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Build, Demo, Pitch! Presentation → Reference Check

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET)
description_html:
About LastPass
LastPass delivers Secure Access Essentials, helping individuals and organizations manage and protect access to AI, applications, and credentials straight from the browser. Trusted by more than 100,000 businesses and millions of users worldwide, LastPass blends strong security with everyday simplicity. From discovering unapproved AI and applications to reducing login friction and securing credentials across the business, LastPass delivers on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected as their environments evolve.

Curious about our products? Visit our website and try it free!

We welcome new ideas, support your growth, and recognize your value, if this aligns with what you are looking for in your next career move, Join Us!

LastPass is looking for Senior Backend Engineer (.NET):

In this role, you will evolve the commerce and payment platforms powering LastPass subscriptions. At this career level, you will modernize services and deliver reliable payment integrations — helping LastPass deliver on its mission to give everyone seamless access to everything they need to work, move fast, and stay protected.

About the team:

The Commerce engineering team sits at the heart of LastPass’s global commerce infrastructure. The team architects, scales, and maintains the backend platforms that drive e-commerce, billing, and payment processing. Working primarily in .NET, the team owns the critical systems that keep LastPass subscriptions running reliably for customers worldwide.

If you are passionate about complex problem solving and motivated by scale, then this is the role for you!

Who will you work with?

You will work closely with fellow .NET engineers, SDETs, QA engineers, database developers, and engineering leaders to design, build, test, and support reliable commerce and payment services. You will also partner with teams across Product, Finance, Data, and Operations to deliver secure and seamless payment experiences for LastPass customers globally.

What are some of the exciting challenges you will be working on?

  • Design and implement scalable .NET services and REST APIs that power commerce and payment capabilities for LastPass customers worldwide
  • Deliver payment gateway integrations and regional payment method support, expanding reach and reliability for LastPass subscribers
  • Contribute to planning, design, and feature delivery in close collaboration with a cross-functional engineering team
  • Advocate for non-functional requirements and cost-effective solutions, developing, testing, and maintaining services within your domain
  • Collaborate across teams, engage in technical decision-making, and help influence the platform’s architectural direction
  • Coach and mentor engineers at various levels, raising the bar for engineering quality and team capability
  • Contribute to a customer-facing application, shaping it with new features that meet evolving user needs and business objectives

What does it take to work at LastPass?

  • Proven experience in C# and .NET Core for web application development
  • Proven experience in REST API design, creation, and consumption
  • Proven experience with relational databases and Entity Framework Core
  • Solid grounding in OOP best practices, containerisation with Docker, and web security principles
  • Proven experience designing and operating microservice architectures
  • Recognised internally as a clear and confident communicator, able to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders with equal ease
  • Approaches complex challenges with a team-first mindset, bringing creative problem-solving and consistent follow-through

It's great, but not required:

  • Ability to create architecture, explain it, and create ADR/RFC documentation

  • Experience with commerce systems and various payment providers

  • Knowledge of Zuora development

  • Experience with AWS, including Secrets Manager (or another cloud provider), and background services

  • Foundational knowledge of Angular

Why LastPass?

  • The leader in secure access
  • High-growth, collaborative environment with inclusive teams
  • Remote-first culture
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible Paid Time Off policies, including but not limited to: Quarterly Self-Care Days (4 extra paid days off annually) and Volunteer Days
  • Parental leave
  • Comprehensive health coverage, including dependents
  • Home office setup support
  • LastPass Families free account for up to 5 members
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities, including an annual learning stipend to invest in your growth
  • Peer-to-peer recognition through Motivosity
  • Employee Assistance Program for well-being support
  • Remote work stipend to support your home office needs
  • Short-Term or Remote-Centric Work Arrangements for added flexibility

Unlock your potential with us - your skills, experience, and unique perspective matter more than just checking the boxes. Apply today, and let's build the future together!

We’re building an inclusive community that reflects the people of all races, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, backgrounds, and perspectives who share our world.

For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join!

As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.

You will review ads in both English and Dutch

This role is great for people who:

- Surf the internet daily

- Use major search engines frequently

- Know what people want based on a few keywords

- Enjoy researching topics online

- Want a flexible and fun side job

Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $14 per hour)

Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in France

Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week.

Start Date: ASAP

Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed

Project Duration: Long-term

Note:

- Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process.

- There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not.

- Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.

  • Strong understanding of English (written and spoken)
  • Comfortable knowledge of modern popular culture
  • Reliable computer system and internet connection
  • Familiar with using online search engines
  • Sign a standard Non-Disclosure Agreement and Service Level Agreement

Compensation

Additional Information

Please note that this work is based on project needs. Due to this, weekly hours may vary and flexibility with change is expected. You must legally be able to work on freelance projects in the France.

title: Pre-sales Manager, Field Engineering - Named Accounts
description_html:
(FEQ427R176)

As a Field Engineering Manager, you will lead a skilled and motivated team of technical pre-sales Solutions Architects and Solutions Engineers based in Denmark. You will play a key leadership role at the intersection of technology and business, helping the team design value-focused solutions and support growth through effective collaboration with Sales and other partners.

You will coach your team to communicate complex ideas clearly and accessibly, supporting strategic sales cycles, and building strong partnerships with customers and stakeholders across large organisations. You will also foster a culture where people with diverse backgrounds feel included, supported, and able to do their best work.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop an inclusive pre-sales team in Denmark, supporting both performance and long-term career growth.
  • Foster a collaborative culture that reflects Databricks’ values of customer focus, teamwork, and diversity of thought.
  • Partner with Sales to drive solution- and value-based selling, helping customers understand the business impact of our platform.
  • Enhance team effectiveness by establishing and iterating on best practices that improve efficiency and focus on meaningful business outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer executives and strategic partners, acting as a credible advisor on data, analytics, and AI.
  • Collaborate across teams—including Marketing, Sales, Product, and Services—to ensure a seamless customer experience and successful implementation.
  • Represent Databricks as part of the regional leadership team and contribute to building our brand and presence in Nordic markets.

What we’re looking for:

*Note - you do not need to fulfil every single requirement to be a strong candidate. If you are excited about this role and have related experience, we encourage you to apply.*

  • Experience managing or leading technical teams in Big Data, Cloud, SaaS, or similarly complex technology environments, or equivalent experience that shows you can quickly learn new technologies.
  • A track record of leading, mentoring, and scaling pre-sales, consulting, or technical field organisations, with an emphasis on coaching and inclusive leadership.
  • Understanding of consumption-based or subscription business models and how technical decisions influence commercial outcomes.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Sales and other cross-functional leaders, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business priorities.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in English required and Danish preferable.
  • Technical background in Data Engineering, Databases, Data Science, or adjacent fields; consulting or customer-facing experience is an advantage.
  • Curiosity and passion for data, AI, and cloud technologies, and the ability to articulate their business value in clear, inclusive language.

Notes:

  • This will be a ‘Remote Contract’ with no formal Databricks office currently in Denmark. However the team do meet weekly/bi-weekly to meet in a coworking space in Copenhagen.
  • If you need any adjustments or accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support you.

#LI-hybrid

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. description_html:
Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world's largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join!

As an Ads Quality Rater , you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you'll tell the AI ​​program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user's keywords.

You will review ads in both English and Czech

This role is great for people who:

- Surf the internet daily

- Use major search engines frequently

- Know what people want based on a few keywords

- Enjoy researching topics online

- Want a flexible and fun side job

Project Details

Job Title: Ads Quality Rater Czech (Slovakia)

Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $8 per hour)

Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Slovakia

Start Date: ASAP

  • Reliable computer system and internet connection
  • Familiar with using online search engines
  • Sign a standard Non-Disclosure Agreement and Service Level Agreement

Compensation

Additional Information

Please note that this work is based on project needs. Due to this, weekly hours may vary and flexibility with change is expected. You must legally be able to work on freelance projects in Slovakia .

title: Technical Consultant
description_html:
We're looking for a Technical Consultant to help deliver customer data migrations and system implementations. You'll work directly with clients and internal implementation teams to convert customer data onto our platform, stand up new customer systems and work on internal technical projects - all while keeping projects on time, on budget, and running smoothly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Migrate customer data from legacy/source systems onto our platform, including writing and troubleshooting custom scripts where needed
  • Write and run SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate customer data
  • Stand up and configure new customer systems/environments as part of implementation
  • Migrate databases to our Azure cloud platform
  • Communicate directly with customers on requirements, timelines, and expectations
  • Work with Project Managers and Implementation teams to flag risks and keep delivery on track
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of our products, tools, and migration methodologies
  • Keep activity reports and project documentation up to date within agreed SLAs
  • Follow company security policies - protecting customer data and reporting any issues

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 1–3 years of relevant technical consulting or data engineering experience preferred
  • Experience writing and troubleshooting SQL (ideally Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL - stored procedures, functions, triggers, indexes)
  • Basic knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs and tools like Postman
  • Basic knowledge of IIS
  • Comfortable communicating with customers on technical requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent work experience
  • Able to work independently and manage your own workload

WHAT WOULD ALSO BE AWESOME:

  • Experience with an ETL toolset (e.g. SSIS)
  • Experience with other RDBMS platforms (Oracle, MySQL, Postgres)
  • Experience with BI Tools (PowerBI, Sigma, Izenda)
  • Familiarity with EDI/integration platforms (e.g. Boomi)
  • Advanced Excel/data manipulation skills

Compensation

Please note that salary estimates provided by websites (LinkedIn, Glassdoor, etc.) and not by WorkWave may not accurately reflect the actual salary range for the position.

Additional Information

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:

• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers

• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses

• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust

• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges

• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us!

LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT:

• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority.

A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:

• We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.

• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming.

• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.

• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.

RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

• Employees can expect a robust benefits package, including 25 days holiday plus an additional 5 days of flexible time off

AND BEYOND...

• Comprehensive financial protection - critical illness cover, income protection, death in service cover and pension contribution

• Wellbeing benefits - Global Wellbeing Program, access to a private GP service, discounted healthcare and paid for counseling sessions

• Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave and pay

• Retail discounts and technology benefits

• Paid time off for volunteering

GROW WITH US:

• We understand the impact of attracting and keeping top talent and reward intellectual curiosity and a thirst for personal and professional growth

• Encouraging our employees that already have an intimate knowledge of and passion for our products to apply for other roles within our walls just makes sense!

• Our employees have access to extensive video libraries for soft skill and role specific training available 24/7 and live trainings are provided throughout the year

JOIN OUR WINNING TEAM!

• 10 Time winner of Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBiz!

• WorkWave has been recognized with multiple awards for its outstanding products, growth and culture, including the Inc. 5000, SaaS Award, IT World Awards, Globe Awards, Silver Stevie Award for Employer of the Year, and Best Place to Work Inc. Magazine

• Recently named one of The Software Report's 3rd annual list of the Top 100 Software Companies of 2022 (worldwide!)

title: Leather Material Developer
description_html:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

JOB TITLE

Leather Material Developer

Summary: At Quince, we are committed to crafting premium leather products that exemplify luxury, durability, and timeless design. We are looking for a Leather Material Developer to advance material quality, enhance supply chain consistency, and establish a strategic Leather Library to spur innovation across our product categories.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, benchmark, and archive premium leather materials for handbags, small leather goods, belts, and accessories.
  • Establish and maintain a centralized Leather Library to ensure consistency and facilitate innovation.
  • Define and implement rigorous quality standards for leather performance, durability, and aesthetics.
  • Collaborate with QA/QC teams to address defects, color variation, and wear issues.
  • Identify and evaluate global leather suppliers ensuring traceability and ethical sourcing.
  • Manage vendor performance, negotiate terms, and drive continuous improvement in material quality.
  • Work closely with design, product development, and supply chain teams to align material innovation with brand positioning.
  • Provide technical expertise to support new product launches and premium collections.
  • Monitor supply chain risks and ensure compliance with sustainability and regulatory standards.
  • Implement traceability systems to strengthen transparency and accountability.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Leather Technology, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in leather material development, sourcing, or QA/QC within luxury or premium brands.
  • Strong knowledge of leather tanning, finishing, and testing methods.
  • Proven track record in vendor management and supply chain optimization.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills; ability to collaborate across global teams.
  • Passion for craftsmanship, innovation, and sustainability in leather goods.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$1—$2 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description_html:
Lunar Energy was founded to transition homes to 100% clean energy—making our electricity greener, our air cleaner and our energy more safe, secure and reliable for all. We’re a fast-growing, global company building the world’s best clean energy products to electrify all homes and connect communities to form clean, resilient virtual power plants.

We are now seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Supervisor to join our UK Customer Support & Engineering team in our London office. In this role, you’ll carry out on-site work (consisting of maintenance jobs) while ensuring exceptional quality of work by our Subcontractors’.

Further, you will offer electrical installation expertise across the business and specifically to the Engineering team in delivering new products and services. You’ll also play a key role in shaping installation processes for new products, supporting engineering teams, and upholding the highest standards in safety and compliance.

This is a rare opportunity to join a rapidly scaling clean-tech company where you will directly influence field operations, improve processes, and pioneer installation approaches for next-generation energy technologies. If you thrive in dynamic environments, enjoy innovating, and love working with technical products, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Site visits: Lead on-the-road hardware maintenance and own responsibilities related to the company vehicle.
  • Lab & maintenance work: Lead electrical planning and maintenance in the lab, including the rooftop solar setup, working alongside the Test Engineer.
  • Safety & quality management: Foster a safety culture, conduct inspections, and ensure all equipment is correctly installed and protected.
  • Audits: Develop, document, and roll out a new auditing process across the subcontractor network.
  • Accreditations: Will to achieve NICEIC/NAPIT accreditation and sign off all completed work, notifying relevant bodies as necessary.
  • Lead new product testing (Installation side): Lead the testing and design of installation processes for all new products with the Engineering Team.

Required experience:

  • Significant experience working on electrical installations
  • Competence working with:
    • 3-phase systems
    • Solar PV systems
    • EVCP Installations
    • AC and DC wiring systems
    • Battery storage systems
    • Communication systems

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Electrical Installation experience (Min 5 years)
  • Previous experience as a Qualified supervisor with an awarding organisation such as NICEIC, NAPIT or Similar (minimum 2 years experience)
  • Experience working to Microgeneration Certification Scheme (MCS) standards
  • Ability to develop and produce safe systems of work and associated RAMS
  • Experience installing, commission and fault finding Electric Vehicle Charge Points (EVCPs)
  • Understanding of battery charging profiles and multi-stage charging mechanics
  • Hands-on experience in installing some or all of the following products / manufacturers: Victron, Pylontech, BYD, Alfen, Varta, Alpha
  • Experience with Sales force or similar CRM
  • Ability to interrogate online system data and proactively identify faults within a fleet of connected devices
  • An understanding of energy import/export and G98/99/100 requirements
  • Experience in the installation, commissioning, and fault-finding of serial communication networks, such as CAN bus and RS485/Modbus
  • Strong attention to detail, commitment to safety and quality, and eagerness to grow technical capability
  • Ability to think outside the box and to develop solutions to complex problems
  • Flexibility in working hours and ability to travel across the UK

Required Skills & Certifications:

Core competency

  • JIB Gold Card - NVQ3
  • City & Guilds 2365 Level 3 Course (Diploma in Electrical Installation) or equivalent
  • Ongoing & Active CPD log

Wiring Regulations

  • City & Guilds 2382-26 (Level 3 Award in the Requirements for Electrical Installations (Ideally to latest amendment)

Inspection and testing

  • City & Guilds 2391-52 (Level 3 Award in Initial Verification and Periodic Inspection and Testing) or equivalent

Health and Safety

  • Institution of Occupational Health and Safety (IOSH) Qualification or similar
  • CDM Overview (or equivalent awareness)
  • Working at Height
  • Manual Handling
  • Asbestos awareness
  • First Aid Training

Role specific

  • Level 3 Award in the Installation and Maintenance of Small-Scale Solar PV Systems
  • Level 3 Award in the Design, Installation and Commissioning of Small Electrical Energy Storage System
  • Inverter/battery manufacturer specific training

Joining us gives you:-

  • Competitive Salary and stock options package
  • Private Medical Insurance scheme through BUPA (medical history disregarded);
  • A wellbeing and lifestyle benefits plan through Medicash
  • Enhanced Pension contributions: employer contributions matching 5%
  • A budget for work related training of £1,000 per financial year and an allowance of 4 training days
  • Cycle To Work scheme and Workplace Nursery benefit
  • Access to Spill - Mental Health Support platform
  • Enhanced Maternity + Paternity Pay
  • 25 days annual holiday entitlement + 8 Bank Holidays
  • Flexible start and finish times, fully remote working or hybrid depending on preferences

Location: You will work from our London office (located close to Spitalfields Market) at least one day a week, and will be expected to travel across the UK as and when needed

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

description_html:
SLSQ327R41

Want to help solve the world's toughest problems with data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks.

Databricks operates at the leading edge of the Data and AI space. Our customers turn to us to lead the accelerated innovation their businesses need to gain first-mover advantage in today's ultra-competitive landscape.

We are looking for a creative, delivery-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to join the team in the Nordics to maximise the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks Denmark. As an Account Executive, you know how to sell innovation and value to existing customers, identify new use cases and grow consumption and can guide deals forward to compress decision cycles. You love understanding a product in depth and are passionate about communicating its value to customers and partners. You will be offered huge potential for career progression with the pace of the team's growth.

You will report to the Sales Director for Denmark and Norway.

The impact you will have:

  • You will co-develop a business plan, with your team and ecosystem partners, that accelerates customer success to exceed quarterly/annual consumption and booking goals
  • You will lead your team, customers and partners to identify impactful data and AI use cases whilst proving out their value on the Databricks Data Intelligence platform
  • You will implement the data and AI transformation goals of your customer through a combination of strategic partnerships, well scoped professional services, training and targeted Executive engagement
  • You will develop an understanding of technical product details and roadmap to build trust with executives and technical champions

What we look for:

  • Exstensive experience selling complex solutions to Enterprise Customers
  • You will have experience managing and leading complex, federated sales campaigns in major accounts
  • You will have experience working in Data, Cloud industries with some technical sales experience
  • Proof of exceeding sales quotas in high-growth Enterprise software companies
  • You will have experience driving consumption and commit-based engagement models and strategies working with professional services and training teams
  • You will have experience co-selling and scaling your business with Cloud Vendors (AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams) and Global Solution Integrators (GSI)
  • Experience of building effective champions, collaborative teams and partnerships to support execution of your account / territory plan
  • Understanding of how to identify all key uses cases and buying centres in an opportunity to increase the impact of Databricks in an organisation
  • Experience of following robust sales methodologies and process, e.g. account planning, MEDDPICC, Value Selling and accurate forecasting
  • Bachelor's Degree or relevant work experience
  • Fluency in English is required

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

description_html:
As a Mid-Market Account Executive at HubSpot you will be engaging directly with small to medium sized businesses, helping them to grow. You will use proactive and inbound selling strategies to find and close new business, and increase the customer's usage of the HubSpot platform over time. You will use your knowledge of digital transformation and change management to act as a trusted advisor and business consultant to the customer, running the sales process end to end with them.

We are looking for the successful candidate to join our team as a remote employee based in Germany. Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot: How We're Building a Hybrid Company.

Responsibilities of an Account Executive:

  • Develop and be responsible for your own annual, quarterly and monthly territory business plan
  • Find new prospects from both inbound and self-sourced leads
  • Run qualification calls with C-level executives and department leaders
  • Close both new business and install base at or above quota on a monthly cadence
  • Sell through internal champions to multiple stakeholders, as well as directly to C -level
  • Work collaboratively with HubSpot's marketing and technology departments to evolve our sales strategy when new features and products are introduced
  • Run online and occasionally in person product demonstrations

Role requirements:

  • 3-5 years in a quota carrying role
  • Fluency in English and German
  • Experience in a complex selling environment
  • Have presented and pitched to C-level executives on a business change
  • Management of monthly and annual pipeline as well as proven accuracy in forecasting
  • Goal orientated with track record of overachieving on monthly & annual targets
  • Trained and/or certified in a standardised sales method (E.g. Sandler)

Who exceeds in this role? Top performers will demonstrate:

  • An understanding of how businesses grow, and confidence advising C-level executives on growth strategies
  • Genuine curiosity about business and technology
  • A growth mindset and a habit of seeking feedback for self development
  • High performance in areas outside of professional work (E.g hobbies, side business, sport, creative)
  • Having taken on additional responsibility in a team environment (E.g coaching, mentoring, team projects)

What are some of the benefits of working at HubSpot?

  • Generous remuneration and stock units
  • Interactive employee training and onboarding
  • An education allowance up to €4,250 per annum
  • Life Assurance
  • Long term illness cover
  • 25 days holidays and unlimited vacation
  • Fitness reimbursement
  • Amazing colleagues to learn from and enjoy company social outings, parties, and events

Pay & Benefits

In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

€110.896—€129.724 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst
description_html:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Instructure is looking for a high-performing Revenue Operations Analyst to support our global Sales Operations function. Reporting to the Director of Planning and Analytics, this role partners across Business Units to deliver data-driven insights on bookings, pipeline health, and sales performance. You'll build the reporting and analysis that helps leadership make faster, better-informed decisions. You'll also support the Revenue Operations team on Annual Planning activities.

You'll work closely with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations teams to turn raw data into clear recommendations. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and analytical skills with the judgment to know what a number actually means for the business.

This position can be worked remotely.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain SQL queries and reports that track bookings, pipeline coverage, and conversion, and monitor CRM data quality to resolve issues at the source.

  • Analyze pipeline trends and support the weekly forecasting review cadence with clean, accurate data that flags risk before it becomes a forecast miss.

  • Partner with regional and global Sales Operations teams to keep metric definitions and reporting standards consistent.

  • Build standardized templates for territory planning, account segmentation, and quota allocation, and partner with field Sales Operations business partners to deliver them on schedule during the H2 Annual Planning cycle.

  • Build sales rep capacity models to inform headcount and territory coverage decisions.

  • Translate ad hoc business questions into structured analysis and clear, leadership-ready answers.

  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and reduce manual work, using AI tools where applicable.

  • Contribute to global Sales Operations projects and share practices that scale across regions.

What You'll Need

  • Two or more years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, or a related go-to-market analytical role, preferably within a SaaS or recurring-revenue business.

  • AI fluency, with experience using AI tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity.

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience querying and reporting on data in Salesforce, plus experience building or scoping dashboards in Tableau or a comparable business-intelligence platform.

  • A strong understanding of B2B sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting metrics.

  • Sound business judgment — the ability to turn complex data into clear insights and question assumptions rather than accept them at face value.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings to both frontline teams and senior leadership.

  • High attention to detail and a proactive, adaptable approach suited to a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field, or equivalent job experience.

  • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data platform.

  • Experience with revenue technology platforms, such as Clari and Gong.

  • Experience supporting bookings, pipeline, or forecast analysis across multiple regions or business units.

  • Comfort working across time zones with global stakeholders.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.
